newsitems.title: New Rust update adds livestock, slows the race to vehicles, and finally gives spoiled meat a use
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
The Rust October update adds cows and sheep, along with a biofuel generator, smaller critters, and new loot rooms in the survival game.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: New Rust update adds livestock, slows the race to vehicles, and finally gives spoiled meat a use

newsitems.title: That's some fiiiiine lookin' milk, but Rust devs warn that 'cream is a more powerful consumable'
newsitems.author: Christopher Livingston
newsitems.contents: On the heels of Facepunch Studios adding necks to s&box it has now also added milk to Rust. *️⃣.. Read more.

newsitems.title: LIVESTOCK
newsitems.author: Errn
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="ZF09w_v7Shw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h1]LIVESTOCK[/h1][p][/p][p]This patch we are introducing cows and sheep.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/oct2026_livestock_animals_cows_sheep_2_1080%20%281%29.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h3][b]What resources can THEY GIVE?[/b][/h3][p]Both produce [b]dung[/b], cows produce [b]milk, [/b]and sheep produce [b]wool[/b].[/p][p]They can also be harvested for meat, bones and leather like any other animal.[/p][p]Additionally, you can sell a grown animal to an NPC in the ranch.[/p][h2][b]How to set up a farm?[/b][/h2][p]There are multiple ways to capture wild livestock, some more efficient than others, but they should all be pretty intuitive.[/p][p]When the new navmesh is enabled, [b]NPCs can enter player structures[/b] and respect doors opening/closing, so the sky is the limit.[/p][p]Like plants, they have [b]genetics [/b]and needs, and can be bred to hunt for a god clone.[/p][p]However, the genes won't behave exactly like plants, so old techniques may not apply.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]WILL IT TANK PERFORMANCE?[/b][/h3][p]Each game frame, only a subset of the NPCs are processed, up to a hardcoded max time per frame.

So when we increase the population, the server doesn't directly lose FPS, instead NPCs just become slower to react because we distribute the load across frames automatically when over budget.

We still spent time multithreading and optimising the new navigation system, at least doubling its performance since the last patch.

As usual, we'll be monitoring server performance and fixing problems as they appear.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]LIVESTOCK ECONOMY[/h1][p][/p][p]Growing and caring for your livestock will allow you to access some new resources and rewards.[/p][p]Grown Cattle and Sheep can be sold at a Stable for a variety of resources. Simply lead your animal to the Stables and speak to the new vendor outside, where you will receive a randomized offer based on the gene quality of the animal. You can reject the offer and get another two more times, at which point the vendor will get annoyed and won't want to buy the animal for 15 minutes. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b2411b1/rust_livestock_auctions_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Wool can be harvested from Sheep and traded in to the same vendor, where you will get up the three offers just like when you sell animals. In this case the rewards offered will be based on how much wool you bring in the one go - the maximum being 400. High risk, high reward.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]MILK[/h1][p][/p][p]Cows give you access to a new resource - milk. It can be consumed as is, but if you refrigerate it for 4 hours, you will gain a new option to skim the milk. Skimming the milk will give you two items - Skimmed Milk and Cream. Cream is a more powerful consumable.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/rust_milk_3_1080_jpg.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Milk and Cream can also be used in a variety of crafting recipes. Milk will generally increase the duration of tea effects, while Cream can be used to increase the potency of those effects.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]LIVESTOCK FENCING[/h1][p][/p][p]To help keep your new livestock under control, we've added new animal gate and fence deployables - perfect for keeping your pet animals safe (ish!).[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b2411b1/rust_fence_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]BIOFUEL GENERATOR[/h1][p][/p][p]A way to finally make use of raw or spoiled meat. The Biofuel Generator converts organic matter to low grade, but it must be stirred by hand![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b2911b1/oct2026_Biofuel_Generator_deployable_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]You can fill it up, stir it and let it process. It will take around 30~ minutes before you'll have to stir again, but don't worry - you can hook up some IO to let you know it needs stirring even when you're in the next room.
[/p][p]The amount of low grade you're given depends on the type of organic matter you put in, those with a larger calorific value will give you more low grade.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]CRITTERS AND SWIMMERS[/h1][p][/p][p]Alongside the livestock, we are bringing in some smaller animals to make the world feel more alive! Frogs, Rabbits, Squirrels, Sea turtles, Crabs, and Jellyfish will all be appearing around the island in the biomes that suit them.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b2911b1/rust_squirrel_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/oct2026_Decorativel_animals_frogs_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/oct2026_Decorativel_animals_jellyfish_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Performance[/b][/h2][p]The critters are heavily budgeted and have dedicated behaviours to ensure they don't take up any more server (and client) performance than strictly necessary. For now, they are mostly set dressing, and their performance limits are set with that in mind.[/p][p]Thanks to our many efforts to optimise other aspects of the game, we can use a part of those savings to give the game more life and vibrancy![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]AIR WOLF REPAIRABLE HELIPAD[/h1][p][/p][p]At the start of the wipe the Air Wolf helipad in Bandit Camp will now be in a state of disrepair. The air vehicle vendor NPC will refuse to sell vehicles to anyone until the helipad is repaired.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/martynchapman/2026/September/30_13-24-FondNeonrainbowfish.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Repairing the helipad is a process similar to constructing siege weapons - a certain amount of resources are required and you can transfer resources from your inventory by bashing the helipad with a hammer. Once the helipad is repaired it stays repaired for the duration of the wipe.

The intention is that repairing the helipad requires a communal effort and air vehicles purchased from this vendor should no longer start spawning too quickly into the start of the wipe. If a clan wishes to get quick access to air vehicles they are required to invest a significant amount of resources to do so and they are also opening up access to the vendor to everyone else on the server.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b2911b1/rust_nov2025update_helicopter_balance_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Server admins can change this behaviour via convars [c]vehicle.padrepairsrequired[/c] (if false this change is effectively reverted) and [c]vehicle.setrepairablepads[/c] (force helipad into fully disrepaired/repaired state with 0/1)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]SANDBAG STACKING[/h1][p][/p][p]Sandbags have been reworked. They now have four stages, and each stage is upgraded to the next by stacking another sandbag deployable on top. Each stage grows taller, with the final stage being a pillbox version. All Sandbag skins are supported across all variations.[/p][p]The crating cost of the sandbag deployable has been reduced to account for needing to stack more of them. When found in loot, Sandbag Barricades will now be a stack of 4. We've also increased the total stack size to 20.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]POWERGRID LOOT ROOMS[/h1][p][/p][p]Building on the Powerplant loot room introduced in the Power Trip update, we’ve added new loot rooms to many other monuments. These rooms are locked by default and become accessible once enough Heavy Fuses have been inserted into the Powerplant to generate the required power. The number of Heavy Fuses needed to unlock each room varies, with more challenging monuments requiring more fuses than beginner-friendly ones.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/rust_lootroom_4_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]We won’t spoil the exact locations of these new rooms, but you’ll find them at the following monuments:[/p][list][*][p]Airfield[/p][/*][*][p]Ferry Terminal[/p][/*][*][p]Harbour 1[/p][/*][*][p]Harbour 2[/p][/*][*][p]Ferry Terminal[/p][/*][*][p]Junkyard[/p][/*][*][p]Launch Site[/p][/*][*][p]Military Tunnels[/p][/*][*][p]Nuclear Missile Silo[/p][/*][*][p]Radtown[/p][/*][*][p]Sewer Branch[/p][/*][*][p]Trainyard[/p][/*][*][p]Water Treatment Plant[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]POPULATION DECAY SCALING OF HEAVY FUSES[/h1][p][/p][p]Power phases are intended to fluctuate based on player interaction with the system. This is largely working as we expected on high population servers. However, on servers with lower population, power is often offline for extended periods of time. With the addition of the marketplace needing power to function, this started to lock out basic necessities like trade. To help ease the pain, we’ve made two changes.[/p][p]Firstly, the decay of heavy fuses will now scale with population. If a server has 10 or less players online, heavy fuses will last four times longer. This gradually scales back to normal values at 100. We’ll continue to monitor this and make adjustments as necessary.[/p][p]Secondly, we have moved the location of the small heavy fuse box at the Power Plant. It’s now accessible from outside the building via a broken window. This should help keep minimum power phases online.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/rin/2026/September/29_21-28-LightRhino.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]CLIENT PREDICTED GRENADES/EXPLOSIVES[/h1][p][/p][p]Grenades/C4/Satchels in Rust are server-sided. This means when you left-click, your client will tell the server that it has to spawn the grenade or c4, etc and then we have to wait for the server to do so. With higher ping, this can feel like a substantial wait.[/p][p]
We are now introducing some client prediction when you use a grenade/c4/satchel. This means that throwing these items will now feel way smoother (especially on higher pings) as your local client will simulate what will happen on the server before the server has to tell us, but don't worry: if there are any discrepancies, your client will be corrected. This shouldn't happen too often, but it will kick in when it needs to.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]MACHETE REFRESH[/h1][p][/p][p]This month, another of our old models gets a long-overdue makeover. The new high-quality machete model features high-resolution textures and a new set of animations.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/rust_machete_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]COUNTRY SELECTION UI REFRESH[/h1][p][/p][p]The country selection UI was a bit of a mess when it was first implemented. With it now being a large part of the server browser, we felt it was time to give it its own design and freshen up![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]PERFORMANCE - VIEWMODEL MEMORY[/h1][p][/p][p]We noticed recently that the hands model that forms part of every viewmodel was taking up a surprisingly large amount of memory. Each viewmodel had the same hand mesh included - it was the same mesh but duplicated and bundled with the LR, the Eoka, etc. It wasn't the sort of thing that would have been worth optimising years ago (each one was only 0.9mb) but nowadays we have over 100 viewmodels so it's adding up.[/p][p]We went back through every viewmodel in the game and removed the mesh, then made one standard hands mesh that gets created as well when you equip a viewmodel. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/jarryd-campi/2026/September/rust_ak_inspect_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]This required us to improve some of our internal tooling as not having the mesh included in the viewmodel made it difficult to preview and inspect animations in the Unity editor. Optimisations are important, but generally not at the expense of our internal workflows and efficiency.[/p][p]We removed 133 meshes and saved roughly 100MB of memory in total.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]NEW WORKSHOP SKINNABLE - ALL LADDER HATCHES[/h1][p][/p][p]This month’s workshop skinnable is another four items! The Ladder Hatches:[/p][list][*][p]Ladder Hatch[/p][/*][*][p]Triangle Ladder Hatch[/p][/*][*][p]Armored Ladder Hatch[/p][/*][*][p]Armored Triangle Ladder Hatch[/p][/*][/list][p]This is sure to open up some doors (hatches) to the skinning community! We’ve put in extra effort to make the top and bottom of these hatches unique, so there’s plenty of opportunity to turn your hatch into a delicious pizza. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b2511b1/oct2026_skinnable_ladder_hatches_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To make your own Ladder Hatch skins, head over to the in-game workshop and locate the Ladder Hatch deployable items listed above. From there, you can download the model files and add your own materials.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]PLAGUE DOCTOR HAZMAT SUIT ITEM DLC[/h1][p][/p][h3]The Plague Doctor is in town. [/h3][p]The Plague Doctor delivers no cure - only death and decay. Bring out your dead, or prepare to join them.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b3011b1/30_10-50-StormyBushbaby.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The Plague Doctor Hazmat Suit can be purchased in-game or from the[url="https://rust.facepunch.com/store/hazmat/plaguedoctor"] Rust Steam item store.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]PERFORMANCE - DYNAMIC STORE ASSETS[/h1][p][/p][p]One area where we could save a bit on memory is our in-game store. We use a lot of different assets to have our store looking great. But when playing the game, you literally can't see them, and yet they're still there either actively hogging up memory or putting pressure on Unity's GPU streaming system. So wouldn't it be nice if we didn't have those assets to worry about when we don't need them?[/p][p]Over the past month we've been working on reorganizing how our in-game store deals with assets. We've made a couple important changes:[/p][list][*][p]Store now actively loads and unloads textures when relevant UI pages come in to/out of view[/p][/*][*][p]These assets are no longer part of the core asset bundles meaning they don't get loaded automatically[/p][/*][*][p]Store has been converted to fetch images from our backend infrastructure[/p][/*][*][p]If something goes wrong with our image-serving backend, then game will load local assets[/p][/*][/list][p]You also might see blurred placeholders(done via [url="https://blurha.sh/"]BlurHash[/url]) while fetching fresh images that you don't have cached:[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/2026/September/23_12-22-BossyGyrfalcon.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Not only does this allow us to ship content more easily in the future (though there's more work in that direction), but it also saves us RAM:[/p][list][*][p]-250MB compared to last release build when starting the game[/p][/*][*][p]~450MB when closing the store menu and letting it unload resources after ~1min[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h1]PERFORMANCE - ANIMATION IK JOBS[/h1][p][/p][p]We moved all of our inverse kinematics, which are secondary procedural animations like spine or hand movements, to be multithreaded this week. Previously, they were all running one by one for each player at the end of a frame, right after the animations had played. 
[/p][p]Other than performance, this actually lets us do a couple of things:[/p][p][/p][p]- We can use IK in our new animation subsystems and still keep them multi threaded. Any subsystem can just modify the IK before it runs. 
[/p][p]- We have a lot more control over existing IK, we previously relied heavily on built-in IK from Unity. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Faster:[/b][/p][p]Update: 1.99ms → 1.47ms = -0.52ms~[/p][p]LateUpdate: 0.98ms → 0.27ms = -0.71ms~[/p][p]AnimationGraphFinish: 0.99ms → 0.75ms = -0.24ms~[/p][p][/p][p][b]Worse:[/b][/p][p]DirectorUpdateAnimationBegin: 0.42ms → 0.62ms = +0.20ms~[/p][p]UpdateIkJobData: 0ms → 0.11ms = +0.11ms~[/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Overall:[/b][/p][p]UpdateScene: 9.36ms → 8.29ms = -1.07ms~[/p][p]Director begin+end: 1.41ms → 1.37ms = -0.04ms~[/p][p][/p][p]Performance-wise, the new IK saves us around 1ms of frame time with 100 players in the scene, this will probably be a lot less drastic if you play on a lower-population server and only end up seeing 5-10 players at once. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]RUST RENDER PIPELINE[/h1][p][/p][p]Because Rust has been around for so long, we were still using Unity’s old Built-in Render Pipeline, which has worked for the most part but has been very limiting in the optimisations we can apply and the effects we can render.[/p][p]We have now migrated to the new Rust Render Pipeline, which is a custom Scriptable Render Pipeline made specifically for Rust by our graphics team. This gives us a lot more control over the rendering of Rust as a whole. This wasn’t easy, as we had to remake almost every effect in the game to work with this new pipeline.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/oct2026_rrp_rust_render_pipeline_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The main benefit of this will be performance. At first, you should see slightly better performance in most areas of the game, as the new pipeline comes with less overhead. However, this is just the beginning. Our initial goal was to get this pipeline working in tandem with the original pipeline to ensure everything worked correctly and that we could still switch between them at runtime. Once we have fully transitioned, we will be able to optimise this pipeline further, meaning there will be more performance gains in the near future. We also have plans for improving the quality of graphics in the game where we weren’t previously able to do due to the old pipeline.[/p][p]The Rust Render Pipeline can be toggled via a setting under the experimental tab so players can switch back and forth between pipelines in case there are any issues initially. This setting is only going to be here for the first month in case anyone encounters graphical or performance issues that we missed while testing. Hopefully, after the next patch, we’ll be able to remove this fully and have RRP as the default once we know that no serious issues remain.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]ANTICHEAT: ADDITIONAL SECURE SERVERS[/h1][p][/p][p]Back in March we introduced the ability for servers to [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/news/shipshape#AnticheatTPM20andSecureBootEnforcement"]require TPM + Secure Boot[/url], enabling it for 6 of our own servers. [/p][p]Over the last 6+ months we have seen security feature adoption grow at a steady pace and we're ready to switch more servers to secure, continuing with the following Facepunch servers:[/p][list][*][p]\[US East] Facepunch 1[/p][/*][*][p]\[EA] Facepunch 1[/p][/*][*][p]\[EU] Facepunch 15[/p][/*][*][p]\[EU East] Facepunch 1[/p][/*][*][p]\[EU] Facepunch 16[/p][/*][*][p]\[EA] Facepunch 2[/p][/*][/list][p]Our desired end goal is still to make it global for all servers in Rust, but we still have some ways to go for adoption, see adoption rates over the last 6+ months:[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ryanw/2026/September/29_11-42-QuestionableXenarthra.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If your hardware supports it, we would strongly recommend you take steps to enable these features, see [url="https://support.facepunchstudios.com/hc/en-us/articles/34396134943389-How-to-Turn-On-TPM-Secure-Boot"]this support page[/url]. If you have TPM and Secure Boot already enabled feel free to give a secure server a chance, we were able to determine a [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/news/spring-clean#ANTICHEATUpdateonSecureServerstpm20secureboot"]reduced cheater presence[/url] on these servers a month after release.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]CRASH UPLOADING[/h1][p][/p][p]Last month we fixed EAC preventing the game from dumping crashes. This month we added uploading of crashes to our backend automatically. We now get a direct report when it happens instead of having to chase down players and manually reproduce the crash in our development builds of the game.[/p][p]You should see increased game stability going forward as we can respond to crashes much more effectively now.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]RUST ISLES - TWITCH DROPS[/h1][p][/p][p]Don't forget to tune in to Twitch and catch the last few days of Rust Isles - your favourite creators battling for control of the seas!

newsitems.title: BREACH AND CLEAR
newsitems.author: Errn
newsitems.contents:
[h2]MONUMENT BLOCKERS[/h2][p][/p][p]Monument blockers are a new obstacle we're adding to monuments with red keycard puzzle rooms. They’re intended to slow down early access to the loot at these monuments. They require a significant amount of damage to destroy but once destroyed they won't respawn. You may also find a handful of weaker monument blockers which can be destroyed by melee.[/p][p]We don't think this will have an enormous impact on progression speed but it might make the early wipe a little more interesting for the first joiners.[/p][p]In the event they aren’t destroyed within the first 24 hours, they will start to decay.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_monument_blockers_7_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_monument_blockers_5_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1.02); outline: rgba(205, 65, 43, 0) solid 2px; outline-offset: 0px; animation: 1s ease 0s infinite normal forwards running lightbox-hover; z-index: 1000; background-color: rgb(205, 65, 43); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]UPKEEP GROUP SCALING[/h2][p][/p][p]Starting this month Tool Cupboards will now apply an additional upkeep tax based on the number of players that are in a base. When calculating that number we consider a few things:[/p][list][*][p]Any players directly authed on the TC[/p][/*][*][p]Any players that have been deauthed from the TC in the last 24 hours[/p][/*][*][p]Any players that are authed on a code lock in the base (including guest code access)[/p][/*][*][p]Any players that were deauthed from a code lock in the last 24 hours[/p][/*][/list][p]The upkeep rates are tiered based on number of players:[/p][list][*][p]First 4 players incur no tax[/p][/*][*][p]Next 6 players incur 2% tax per player[/p][/*][*][p]Subsequent players incur 4% tax per player
This means a TC with 6 players authed will have +4% upkeep, a TC with 12 players will have +20% upkeep. There is a maximum tax amount of 300%. You can see the current tax rate being applied by hovering over the upkeep cost while the TC is open.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/rust_tc_groups_1080_1_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Large player groups are a tricky game balance problem to tackle as they essentially bypass most difficulty mechanics in the game via sheer numbers. We don't want to make this an unviable playstyle - Rust is a sandbox best played with friends and we believe you should be able to play it as you see fit.[/p][p]We're hoping this adds an interesting problem for large groups to solve that doesn't come at the expense of small groups and solos as we believe these groups don't really have many interesting gameplay problems to tackle.[/p][p]As usual, we'll monitor this over time and make adjustments as necessary. Server owners will find a set of ConVars in the Decay class that can be used to modify these behaviours, including disabling it entirely.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]HQM NODE AND COLLECTABLE[/h2][p][/p][p]High quality metal ore nodes and collectables can now be found across the island. They're extremely scarce, but you'll have more luck finding the HQM node in the Jungle.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/rin/2026/September/02_19-19-AmusedLamb.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]MARKETPLACE POWER[/h2][p][/p][p]The Drone marketplace is now connected to last months [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/news/power-trip"]Power Plant system[/url], requiring the server to keep the power plant up and running in order to operate drone deliveries. The marketplace now has a built in power level that slowly increases when 4 or more fuses are active in the Power Plant.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/sep2026_drone_marketplace_power_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Once the battery hits 50% it can start accepting purchases. As long as at least one fuse is inserted into the Power Plant the battery won't decrease, but if it drops below 50% then the marketplace will deactivate again.[/p][p]You can see the current charge level from the marketplace map screen.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]MEDICAL HONEY BANDAGE[/h2][p][/p][p]The Medical Honey Bandage is a brand-new healing item on the Workbench Level 1. Designed to bridge the gap between the regular Bandage and Medical Syringe, it gives aspiring beekeepers another way to put their honey reserves to good use. Players with thriving bee farms often end up with more honey than they know what to do with, so we hope this new item makes the surplus feel a little sweeter.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/lukester/2026/September/01_09-15-PinkInganue.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/lukester/2026/September/01_09-16-GargantuanXrayfish.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]ATTACK HELI/HAB CONDITIONAL ARMOUR[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve heard your feedback - the Attack Helicopter is too difficult to counter. [/p][p]Attack helicopters' existing cockpit armour will now fall off in stages as it becomes damaged, exposing both the pilot and gunner. Pilots will now have to be more careful with how close they fly to the sun.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Attack heli armour conditions [/b][/p][list][*][p]80% Left panel - 680hp[/p][/*][*][p]70% Right panel - 595hp[/p][/*][*][p]60% Front panel - 510hp[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/sept2026_heliarmour_falloff_01.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]We can't forget about the armoured HABs though, these will also have conditional armour.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Armoured HAB armour conditions [/b][/p][list][*][p]90% Left panel - 2250hp [/p][/*][*][p]80% Right panel - 2000hp [/p][/*][*][p]70% Back panel - 1750hp[/p][/*][*][p]60% Front panel - 1500hp[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/sept2026_heliarmour_falloff_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]We'll being monitoring your feedback as always.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]MODULAR CAR HANDLING IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p][/p][p]We've given a little bit of love to how modular cars handle. The steering, turning and suspension have all been tweaked to feel better. We have hopefully also improved how well they drive for players with higher latency.[/p][p]As well as that, we have also added a handbrake mechanic, you can activate it by pressing your [b]CTRL[/b] key. Now you will be able to do hairpin turns, take tighter corners, drift, and even do some doughnuts.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/sep2026_Modular_Car_Drifting_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1.02); outline: rgba(205, 65, 43, 0) solid 2px; outline-offset: 0px; animation: 1s ease 0s infinite normal forwards running lightbox-hover; z-index: 1000; background-color: rgb(205, 65, 43); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]RADWATER SPRINKLER BUFF[/h2][p][/p][p]Yes: we are buffing Radwater again. This time we've given it a large buff when used in Sprinklers, specifically against those with armour.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_radioactive_sprinkler_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Radwater will now seep through more armour types, causing significant radiation to those in full kits, or lower radiation protection gear. Hazmats are still an effective counter.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SAM SITE BUFFED VS. DRONES[/h2][p][/p][p]The SAM site will now do a much better job of destroying hostile drones.[/p][p]Missiles will fly faster vs drones and have a larger detonation fuse area, meaning drones get taken down much more reliably.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_drone_SAM_4k.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]NOTABLE CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][p]We've made several smaller balance changes across the board this month, some addressing community pain points.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Heavy Plate Helmet[/b][/p][p]The heavy plate helmet now suppresses noise when worn. We've also increased the crafting costs.[/p][p][b]Heavy Plate Armour[/b][/p][p]Players wearing the Heavy Plate Jacket or Pants will now make noise when moving, audible to other players.[/p][p][b]Swamp Trees[/b][/p][p]The wood harvest from swamp trees has been significantly increased to be in line with other types of trees.[/p][p][b]Semi-Pistol[/b][/p][p]The damage falloff has been increased, meaning less damage at range. We've also increase the crafting cost.[/p][p][b]Pies[/b][/p][p]Various pies have had their durations extended and recipes adjusted. The Hunters pie bleed reduction has increased.[/p][p][b]Grenades[/b][/p][p]Stack sizes have been reduced for the F1, Bee Grenade, Molotov, Flashbangs and Beancans.[/p][p][b]Homing Launcher[/b][/p][p]The homing launcher lock-on duration has been reduced, allowing for earlier firing.[/p][p][b]SMG & Rifle Bodies[/b][/p][p]SMG bodies are now minorly more common, whilst rifle bodies have seen a slight reduction[/p][p][b]Large Medkit[/b][/p][p]The Large Medkit now remove radiation to match the behavior of Medical Syringes.[/p][p][b]Composter[/b][/p][p]You can now see how quickly things will take to turn into fertilizer, your crops will thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]FLASHLIGHT REMAKE[/h2][p][/p][p]Let there be light! [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/alfiebirch/2026/August/sept2026_flashlightredo_01_4k.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]This month, the flashlight has received a new update - featuring a brand new high quality model, high resolution textures, and new animations.  We've also updated the functionality, r/click to turn on/off, just like the torches. You'll even get a different admire animation, based on whether it's on or off![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]ARROW REMAKE[/h2][p][/p][p]Arrows have had a facelift. Wooden arrows have now been updated to have more visual interest (complete with new fletching) and to feel more "RUST".[/p][p]Under the hood, it's been a fiddly one, as each existing weapon contained the arrow mesh directly, so updated rigs and prefabs were required.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/lewist/2026/July/arrow_refresh-2.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/lewist/2026/July/arrow_refresh-4.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]If this felt like dejavu, you're right. We accidentally left it in the last dev blog. It's in-game this time, we promise.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW WORKSHOP SKINNABLE: WOOD ARMOR[/h2][p][/p][p]This month’s workshop skinnable is all four pieces of Wood Armor:[/p][list][*][p]Wood Chestplate[/p][/*][*][p]Wood Armor Pants[/p][/*][*][p]Wood Armor Helmet[/p][/*][*][p]Wood Armor Gloves[/p][/*][/list][p]Branching out to all four Wood Armor pieces this month we’re pining for the community to spruce up the workshop![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_wood_armor_reskin_4_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To make your own Wood Armor skins, head over to the in-game workshop and leaf through the Wood Armor attire items listed above. From there, you can download the model files and add your own materials and make something tree-mendous.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]CRYSTAL ASSAULT RIFLE DLC[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matt.i/2026/September/sep2026_Rust_Crystal_AR_01_Hero_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Machined from the toughest gemstones, this Assault Rifle skin will show each and every shot you take.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matt.i/2026/September/sep2026_Rust_Crystal_AR_02_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); flex-shrink: 1; height: 200px; min-width: 1%; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matt.i/2026/September/sep2026_Rust_Crystal_AR_03_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); flex-shrink: 1; height: 200px; min-width: 1%; display: block;"][/img][/p][p]Coming in 5 unique color variations, the Crystal Assault Rifle shows ammunition in the magazine as well as inner workings of the internals as you fire. [/p][p]The Crystal Assault Rifle can be purchased in-game or from the [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/store/weapon/crystal-ar"]Rust Steam item store[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW WORLD MODELS[/h2][p][/p][p]It's about time world models have a bit of love. This month, we're introducing over 70 new world models to replace the burlap sack. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_new_world_models_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]We went to effort to make sure they were more or as performant than the burlap sack. Dropped items from electrical components to clothing.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NETWORK RANGE AUDIT[/h2][p][/p][p]Lots of the entities in the world are usually networked way before they can be seen by players. Sometimes this happens too far out, so if a player was running through a specific grid: they may be getting network data about entities which they likely won't be super close to. These all add up: resulting in extra network overhead for the client + server. [/p][p][/p][p]A few months ago we rolled out a system that would allow us to have custom network ranges for specific objects: close, standard, far. This has only been setup for the very worst offenders, but now I've had a proper audit of most of our entities and set a huge amount of entities (around 300)  to that 'close' network range. This affects things like signs, mushrooms, driftwood etc, greatly reducing our overhead.[/p][p][/p][p]This won't affect gameplay, and nothing has been reduced which is rendered very far in the distance. We hope to be able to better use this system in the future, but this is a great start.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RANDOM SKIN CRAFTING[/h2][p][/p][p]There's a new "random" skin option at the start of the skin list. With this selected, each craft of that item will get a random, unlocked skin applied.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_random_skin_option_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]This is saved per item, so you can have it activated for some items and keep other items with a specific skin selected.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW NAVMESH[/h2][p][/p][p]We introduced a completely new navmesh in a previous patch, disabled by default, accessible by booting servers with the [b]-useNewNavmesh[/b] command line parameter.[/p][p]We since improved performance a lot, reduced the save sizes, and squashed a lot of bugs.[/p][p]This patch we are going to enable it on some of our servers and monitor how it performs.[/p][p]The goal is to make it the default as a hotfix or as part of next patch if everything goes well.[/p][p]What you can expect as a player:[/p][list][*][p]maybe some animals will enter your base or get in monuments[/p][/*][/list][p]What you can expect as a server owner:[/p][list][*][p]navmesh is saved to disk and loaded when the server restarts, potentially leading to faster boots[/p][/*][*][p]the continuous runtime cost of NPC navigation is lighter on the main thread but uses more background threads[/p][/*][/list][p]This is part of a push to improve performance and stability of NPCs in the long term, but also to have the option to have various NPCs navigate player bases correctly.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]IMPROVED SERVER EVENT SAVING[/h2][p][/p][p]Most Rust servers follow a daily restart schedule, to help with server stability and performance.[/p][p]These restarts should ideally be fast and not affect gameplay in any way, so players can just keep going about their business after rejoining.[/p][p]Until now, this wasn't the case with some of the game's biggest events, such as oil rig - if you happened to be taking rig at an unlucky time and got interrupted by the server going down, all of the loot crates and most importantly, the hackable locked crate would just disappear.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/sep2026_server_event_save_loading_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]This month I've been working on fixing these kinds of issues by improving the way the server saves and loads the state of these events. Affected are the oil rigs, cargo ship, patrol helicopter, Bradley and satellite crash sites.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/sep2026_server_event_save_loading_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1.02); outline: rgba(205, 65, 43, 0) solid 2px; outline-offset: 0px; animation: 1s ease 0s infinite normal forwards running lightbox-hover; z-index: 1000; background-color: rgb(205, 65, 43); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PAINT BRUSH VISUALIZER[/h2][p][/p][p]A new option has been added to the painting UI that projects the current paintbrush onto the object you are painting! This should help out a lot when you're painting with different brush sizes and textures at varying zoom levels.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]WATER TREATMENT PLANT MAINTAINABLE MINI REWORK[/h2][p][/p][p]The pressurized tank and gearboxes in water treatment plant have received a mini rework for simplification.[/p][p]Each gearbox turned fully will provide 3 hours real time of water flow to the pipes. The maximum pressure of the tank when both gearboxes are turned is enough to keep the pipes operational for, you guessed it, 6 hours.[/p][p]In addition, the amount of water produced by the pipes now scales linearly with the amount of pressure in the tank. You can check the pressure at the maintenance hut where the ground-floor gearbox is.[/p][p]When the tank runs out of pressure and no water is being produced, the pipes around the map will now start to lose water as well.[/p][p]To compensate for some losses, the IO output has been increased. The numbers should balance out to be one water pipe being roughly equivalent to 2 pumps, with better IO push rates. The amount of pipes on the map has also been increased and should be more consistently placed.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]PERFORMANCE - PHYSICS IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p][/p][p]We've customized the physics engine (PhysX) further this month, tailoring it more and more to Rust. We've added an entirely new broadphase mode, using a BVH structure that we've also applied to the underlying structures used for physics queries.[/p][p]In simple terms, the old implementations for these used to scale with the number of colliders in the world which is constantly growing during a wipe cycle. Now these scale more with the number of [i]changes[/i] that are being made which scales more with the number of active players and at a much better rate.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/graham/2026/September/01_09-11-SoreDalmatian.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The data above is comparing the weekend before updating the physics engine and the weekend after, on this particular server it doubled performance. [/p][p]As always, the server will get the most benefit from these changes as it's generally just doing a lot more. However, the client will always get a benefit from these changes as well.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]PERFORMANCE - SCRIPTING MULTITHREADING[/h2][p][/p][p]One of the core rules of Unity is that you have to call scripting APIs from the main thread. So things like accessing a gameobject's transform or even accessing current time (Time.time) has to be done on main thread. This makes it very awkward and sometimes limiting to push parallelization into the game code. [/p][p]But Unity enforces these checks only in Editor and debug build environments - Release builds strip out these checks for performance reasons. So we could technically write code for editor that plays by the rules, while in Release plays fast-and-dangerously, but that would be a giant headache to validate and debug.[/p][p]This month me and [b]octo[/b] found a way to trick Unity into thinking any thread to be a main thread. This allows us to unify implementations and test things in editor with confidence. This opens the door to speed up parts of code that weren't available before - but this isn't free lunch, Unity can have internal synchronization or design that doesn't assume that it'll be interacted with concurrently (which can lead to bugs). And we still need to amend code to benefit from it.[/p][p]For technical details to other unity devs/users, it's a 2 step process - there's an editor-only managed code side check (Object.EnsureRunningOnMainThread) that can be replaced with a dud, and there's a native memory TLS variable that can be set from 0 to 1 to tell unity "this is a main thread" (which one can identify by scanning all TLS variables on main thread and looking to ones storing 1). Different builds and platforms will have different TLS locations, as well as memory protections to modify memory directly.[/p][h2][b]Improving Parallel Server Occlusion Generation[/b][/h2][p]To test it, I trialled it out on Server Occlusion generation - there's a couple phases that the process goes through, and certain steps are easy to parallelize. Those are: sampling unity's terrain mesh heights and filtering physics query results if they have a component. In both cases it's 2 single line loops.[/p][p][b]Before: 44s for 4.5k world[/b] - only the orange blocks have native thread parallelism, so I didn't include managed worker threads display[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/2026/August/21_00-08-HollowEuropeanfiresalamander.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][b]After: 22s for 4.5k world[/b] - the blue scatter plot bellow are all managed worker threads being busy[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/2026/September/01_12-16-SpecificHairstreakbutterfly.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 806px; height: 200px; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; margin: 16px auto; max-width: 100%; display: block;"][/img][/p][p]To be fair, it's not exactly apples to apples comparison - I've tweaked a couple things that gave 8s of speedup on it's own, so the actual speedup we got from using async tasks is [b]37s -> 22s[/b].[/p][p]Also, that whole "no free lunch" line - Unity, sadly, has a bunch of synchronization in play that strangles performance:[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/2026/September/01_12-27-GainsboroSiamesecat.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 806px; height: 200px; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; margin: 16px auto; max-width: 100%; display: block;"][/img][/p][p]In the future I hope to engage it in more places, but it'll be a gradual process.[/p][h2][b]Mutex Pool Deprecation[/b][/h2][p]While working on a new Pool implementation I've kept around original Mutex pool as a fallback. I haven't heard of any issues this month, so with this patch I'm treating it as deprecated and it will be removed in the next patch.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SALVAGED HAMMER REFRESH[/h2][p][/p][p]The hammer was another model looking very dated, so we've given it a refresh. The new high-quality model features high-resolution textures, and a new set of animations.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/sept2026_salvagedhammerredo_tabletop_02.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1.02); outline: rgba(205, 65, 43, 0) solid 2px; outline-offset: 0px; animation: 1s ease 0s infinite normal forwards running lightbox-hover; z-index: 1000; background-color: rgb(205, 65, 43); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PERFORMANCE - MEMORY IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p][/p][p]We've made a variety of memory improvements this month across many parts of the game:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the memory usage of a lot of objects in the world, by very small amounts on each object but it adds up to about 15k less objects/10mb of memory[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the texture size of many ambient occlusion textures resulting in a reduction of ~630mb, with almost no visual difference, this would affect VRAM usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the texture size of distant objects, more VRAM saving[/p][/*][/list][p]We've also identified a few more areas to improve that we should be able to implement next month.[/p][p]Early testing is showing a healthy memory saving of over 0.5GB but this will vary between machines. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/jarryd-campi/2026/August/Unity_Ghl8E5gtRQ.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]PERFORMANCE - VEHICLE POOLING[/h2][p][/p][p]Vehicles cause a lot of stutters when you're just roaming the world, unlike other entities - vehicles currently get fully destroyed and recreated whenever they're outside of your network range, this can cause really bad stutters somewhere in the range of 20-30ms which is longer than a couple of frames depending on your framerate. 
[/p][p]Pooling is used on most other entities, instead of fully destroying an entity and recreating it, we just disable them and re-use them as needed. With the complexity of vehicles, especially the modular ones, it took a lot longer to get pooling working without any major issues popping up. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/adam-k/vehicle_pooling_profiles.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The new profiles are from me moving out of range and coming into range of all of the vehicles in the game, the left over spikes in the bottom screenshot are just from editor code.
[/p][p]Overall, you should see a lot less noticeable stutters playing the game, there is still more work to be done with pooling for things like player boats. That might be my next area to look into. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]DEMO IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/adam-k/rust_demo2.0_6_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The new UI has been getting a lot of fixes and improvements based on feedback from our internal trailer team as well as the community. I think it's slowly getting to a point where we can turn it on by default, until the next patch you can participate in testing it by using [b]demo.newui[/b] 1 in the console.[/p][p]As for the improvements: I fixed a bunch of UX issues with the UI, fixed undo not working with dolly camera, added a preview in dolly edit mode so you don't need to hop between the two views too often - plus a bunch of other improvements. [/p][p]I also redesigned the sandbox panel to prepare it for future improvements, one of those future improvements is parenting which is already in this update. You can parent lights to players at the moment, in the future you'll be able to parent more things to each other. [/p][p]There's also a new curve editor to allow you to animate keyframes with a lot more freedom, you can use it with dolly cameras to create speed ramping or slow the camera down as it sweeps through. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0211b1/rust_demo_curve_editor_2_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]I'm looking forward to seeing what people create![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]FACEPUNCH SERVERS[/h2][p][/p][p]To consolidate players, we are retiring the following servers[/p][list][*][p]EU Primitive 2[/p][/*][*][p]CAN Primitive 1[/p][/*][*][p]US West Primitive 1[/p][/*][/list][p]If you were playing on any of the above, don't fear. There will still be Facepunch primitive gamemode servers in these regions.[/p][p]We are reducing the map size from 4250 to 3750 on the following servers[/p][list][*][p]EU Hardcore 1[/p][/*][*][p]US East Hardcore 1[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Full devblog here: [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/news/breach-and-clear"]https://rust.facepunch.com/news/breach-and-clear[/url][/p]

newsitems.title: POWER TRIP
newsitems.author: Errn
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="ynUzYLpvmXs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]PLAYER MAINTAINED MONUMENTS[/h2][p][/p][p]This month we're releasing a set of features we call Player Maintained Monuments - tying together our existing monuments in new and interesting ways while pushing players to interact with each other in the process.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]POWERING UP THE POWER PLANT[/h2][p][/p][p]Using new Heavy Fuses, the power plant can be fired back up to unlock several new gameplay features for everyone around the island.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/martynchapman/2026/August/rust_powerfuses_4_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Heavy Fuses can be found as loot and must be inserted into the new special fuse boxes located at the power plant. Not everything will be unlocked all at once - some things connected to the power plant require more fuses than others to become functional.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/martynchapman/2026/August/rust_powerfuses_3_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Once the power plant has started providing power, the powerline poles with transformers (the white cylinder-looking things) which appear alongside roads can now provide power for electrical circuits. These powerlines can also now be climbed - no need for a ladder, just approach the powerline and jump.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/martynchapman/2026/August/aug2026_powerlines_02.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Green recyclers (the ones outside of safezones) have received a 10% nerf to their baseline efficiency of 50%, being restored to 60% with sufficient power from the power plant and additionally receiving a duration buff from 5s to 4.5s once the power plant is at maximum power. Yellow recyclers (inside safezones) remain unchanged from their previous behaviour. We have also added a single special new red recycler with 75% efficiency to the power plant, only usable at maximum power.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SATELLITE CRASH[/h2][p][/p][p]A new in-game event![/p][p]Power up the new Satellite Control Computer at the Launch Site with tech trash and an aiming module and then take control of a satellite of your choosing.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/aug2026_satellite_01.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Use the thruster buttons to target the crash location before locking it in. It doesn't come with a manual though, so you'll have to figure out which thruster button does what, first![/p][p]Once locked in, the satellite will start its descent, visible to all players on the server. After a short while it will impact and spill its new satellite loot crates.[/p][p]Once they've cooled down, they're ready to loot - but the whole server knows about them too![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]DOME PUMPING[/h2][p][/p][p]Once the Power Plant is running, a new switch on the Large Oil Rig will become usable. This controls the flow of crude oil to Dome. Once activated, this will pump Crude for 20 minutes.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/rust_domepump_5_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]However, you can't retrieve it by yourself - you'll need to use the Tanker vehicle module to drain the oil and then transport it to a car lift to extract it. [/p][p]There is also a switch on Small Oil Rig that pumps at half the rate. You can enable both switches at once to get 1.5x the Crude.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SUPERMARKET FREEZER[/h2][p][/p][p]There is a new freezer located inside the Supermarket that provides a steady stream of chilled food so long as it is receiving power from the power plant.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/rust_supermarket_fridge_3_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Every so often, it will provide a larger food cache than usual. Happy shopping![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]WATER TREATMENT PLANT PRODUCTION[/h2][p][/p][p]Water pipes will now spawn around the roadsides of the map. To start, the pipes will be empty and won't produce any water. To get them to start pumping, the Water Treatment Plant will have to be maintained.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/aug2026_watertreatment_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Two gearboxes have been added inside the monument, and turning them pressurises the new intact water tank at its centre. To get a gearbox moving, the powerplant's grid needs to be live, then you'll need to place a gear into the gearbox and interact with it to start the valve wheel spinning. Gears are consumed as the wheel turns and can't be pulled back out once inserted.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/aug2026_watertreatment_07.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]When the tank reaches full pressure, the blades will start spinning and clearing up the blockages, restoring water flow across the map. After that, coming back every once in a while to keep the pressure up and the blockages clear will be much easier than a cold start.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]GAS STATION CAR GARAGE[/h2][p][/p][p]In Oxum's, the car garage has received a tune-up. When the power grid is active, or when the backup generator around the side is turned on, the garage will power up with some new features.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/rust_gas_station_1_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The garage door can be opened or closed with a switch on the outer wall, so long as that switch has power.[/p][p]Inside the garage, the car lift will be operable and ready for business. Lower it down using the controls and drive a car on to start using it just like any other car lift. When you're done, raise the lift back up and head down into the cave for a chance at higher quality car part spawns![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]AIRFIELD TERMINAL TOWER[/h2][p][/p][p]A newly refreshed control tower has hit the airfield. On the second floor, you'll find two new terminals that charge up from fuse boxes connected to the power grid. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/Aug2026_player_maintained_Monuments_Airfield_Terminals_2_4K.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The smaller terminal will increase the rate at which air drops fall across the map when charged.[/p][p]When the [i]larger [/i]terminal is charged, a Chinook resupply crate can be called in to drop a crate near the airfield tarmac.[/p][p]The terminals will slowly lose charge after they are activated. Once they've drained the residual charge completely, they will be available for use again.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BAR GAMES PACK DLC[/h2][p][/p][p]This month we’re serving up the Bar Games Pack. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0511b1/bar_games_pack_hero_01.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Get your buddies together and come on down to the Bar Games Pack. Featuring the unique and complex mini-games Pool and Darts, and a range of bar game-themed items to turn any base into the hottest joint in town. [/p][p]Both the Pool Table and the Dart board are self-contained mini-games for both solo and multiplayer fun. Deploy them in your base, interact and play them in real-time, setting your score for others to beat. 

The Pool Table allows one/two players to have a classic game of pool! It can be placed down as a normal deployable. Players will then walk around the table, jump on to get ready to hit the cue ball and pick their desired power amount before flicking their mouse up to shoot. Standard pool rules apply![/p][p]Other items include an interactive Juke Box deployable, skins for the Mini Fridge and Shotgun Trap, unique bar stools seating, and themed wallpapers and sprays. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0511b1/rust_games_DLC_minifridge_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 244.656px; height: 200px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0511b1/rust_games_DLC_jukebox_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 244.672px; height: 200px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0511b1/rust_games_DLC_stools_6_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 244.672px; height: 200px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0511b1/rust_games_DLC_tiktak_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit;
