This interactive deployable lets you carve away at stone until you create the shape of your heart’s desire. Or just sculpt your favourite appendage. Either is a surefire way to stand proud.[/p][p]The Stone Sculpture can be purchased in-game or from the [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/store/misc/stonesculpture"]Rust Steam item store.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RESPAWN POINT IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p][/p][p]You can now toggle a respawn option (bag/bed/etc) to display on the compass. Only one can be marked at once, and you need to interact with the bag directly to enable it. The thinking is that this will free up the standard "home" map marker.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/rust_sleeping_bag_compass_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]You can also now Favourite bags on the death screen, these bags will appear first in the respawn list.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RECYCLE BIN WORKBENCH UPGRADE.... UPGRADE[/h2][p][/p][p]The Recycle Bin workbench upgrade got an upgrade of its own![/p][p]It now has its own inventory, which can be accessed by interacting with the bin itself.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/may2026_workbenchupgrades_04.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]All bonus items returned by the Recycle Bin upgrade now go directly into this new inventory, ready for you to collect at your convenience![/p][p]It's take-only though, so you can't fill it with loot yourself.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NODES IN SAFE ZONES[/h2][p][/p][p]Ore nodes and woodpiles can no longer spawn in safe zones. [/p][p]As they could only be harvested using a rock, they tended to pile up and eventually drained the global spawn population, preventing new nodes from appearing elsewhere on the map.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Flavien/rust_node_spawn_1_4k.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 0px 0px 3px 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto 0px;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]WOLF HEADDRESS BALANCE & QOL[/h2][p][/p][p]The Wolf Headdress has always been a strong option early and mid wipe, providing good head protection and the ability to be combined with a bandana. To give other helmets a chance as a viable alternative in early bow fights, we have decided to lock its crafting behind needing a Tier 1 workbench.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/cipeax/2026/August/rust_wolf_headdress_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Also, a quality of life improvement is coming to the lunar new year animal masks. These have always had the same stats as the Wolf Headdress, and have now been set up as skins, allowing you to freely re-skin between all of the variants, and avoiding clutter in the crafting menu.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]TOGGLING SHIELDS[/h2][p][/p][p]You can now swap between having the shield on your back and aiming down sights vs. having it to the side and blocking with it. [/p][p]To do so, go to your settings panel and set up the bind. Once you have it set, you can switch between the two stances every couple of seconds.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0411b1/rust_shieldtoggle_2_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]We added a cooldown to the stance switching to prevent players from spamming it - it'd lead to more randomness in gun fights rather than players strategically sticking to one stance. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]HIGH WALL UPKEEP[/h2][p][/p][p]Players have found ways to claim large areas of the map by spamming deployables as long as the game has been alive, whether it's been pillars, TCs or high walls. Changes in the past have helped address this, such as upkeep and adding a sheet metal crafting cost to high stone walls. This is another step forward to reducing the effectiveness of blocking access to large areas of the map.[/p][p]High walls now have a static upkeep cost of 20%. This brings them in the middle of building blocks (10% -> 33%) to keep them the intended way to make compounds while discouraging spamming them.[/p][p]This makes it more expensive and a hassle to come up with enough upkeep for external TCs if you don't want to keep refilling them. It should also help clear up old compounds after a base is raided.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/rust_highexternalwall_deploy.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 0px 0px 3px 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto 0px;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]WATER WELL VENDOR STOCK[/h2][p][/p][p]Water wells are a great stepping stone into the world of farming by allowing you to get a taste of tea buffs and high level tools. However, over time (and especially with the extra influx of scrap from the blueprint update), more and more players started using it as an alternative to farming. In the most extreme example, you could buy 10x jackhammers and 10x advanced teas a few hours into wipe, leading to much faster progression than intended.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/Aug2026_Waterwell_vendor_1_4K.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To return to its intended function, we kept the prices the same but reduced the stock that each water well vendor has.[/p][list][*][p]Stock lowered from 10 -> 2[/p][/*][*][p]Restock time increased from 2m -> 10m[/p][/*][/list][p]
This should allow you to use it as a quick boost without it becoming an alternative to the intended farming progression of setting up farms and cloning plants.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]HOVER LOOTING FIX[/h2][p][/p][p]This is a "relatively minor bug" but it needed a dedicated section in the blog to explain it properly.[/p][p]In Rust's inventory system, when holding ALT, it will try to move the item "onto your player".[/p][p]Examples:[/p][list][*][p]move into backpack before main inventory[/p][/*][*][p]wear clothing instead of dumping in chest[/p][/*][*][p]move from backpack to main inventory instead of dumping in chest[/p][/*][*][p]equip clothing instead of putting into main inventory[/p][/*][/list][p]The bug was "hover looting a body bag corpse would do nothing if it needed to swap clothing". When nothing happened, you would try to hover loot again... and it still wouldn't work. Next, you would panic and try to manually swap the items.. which still wouldn't work. So finally, in the middle of the fight you would start unequipping your current armour just to be able to equip the armour off the body bag.[/p][p]This is fixed so it works intuitively. It will now allow you to swap clothing despite the inventory being locked and put the clothing you are taking off into your main inventory. There is also special handling so if your inventory is completely full, it will move the clothing you are taking off into the body bag you are looting. [/p][p]This should reduce frustration when looting clothing from corpses in big fights and raids.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]MASTER KEY[/h2][p][/p][p]Last month, the Master Key used in the Apartment Complex shipped without a model. Of course, none of you noticed because nobody would ever break into their poor neighbour's apartment for scraps, right?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5377070/419e41143a0e3e7d88cac6bd7036a45a14b8e121.png"][/img][/p][p]It now has a fully functional view model and animations, so the experience of cracking open your neighbour's apartment can feel even better.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]ARROW REVAMP[/h2][p][/p][p]Arrows have had a facelift. Wooden arrows have now been updated to have more visual interest (complete with new fletching) and to feel more "RUST".[/p][p]Under the hood, it's been a fiddly one, as each existing weapon contained the arrow mesh directly, so updated rigs and prefabs were required.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/lewist/2026/July/arrow_refresh-2.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/lewist/2026/July/arrow_refresh-4.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]DEMO UI 2[/h2][p][/p][p]The demo UI got a complete makeover; everything in the UI was recreated from scratch, not only to be much easier to use but also to provide powerful features for both our internal trailers and content creators.[/p][p]Most of this was just done in my free time as a love letter to video game editing communities, as being a part of them when I was younger led me to working on Rust. This explains why it wasn't on any of the roadmaps. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0511b1/rust_demo2.0_4_1080_jpg.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]One of the main goals of the new UI is to ease the learning curve needed to create basic content. Previously, you needed a lot of binds and console commands for even the simplest cinematics, with the new features, you should be able to access everything from the UI.

Some of the features that will help you with that are:[/p][list][*][p][b]Options panel [/b]- a set of sliders and toggles that let you control the camera, depth of field, time of day and post processing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dolly camera[/b] - lets you place cameras at any point in time and sweep through them. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Keyframe timeline[/b] - animate any slider in the options panel to create things like cool timelapses, sweep the focus distance, etc.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sandbox mode[/b] - clone players, place lights, with more features coming in the future.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scene system[/b] - Do all of the above, create variations, its our equivalent of project files within a demo. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Change appearance[/b] - You can change the clothing and seed of any player or hide them altogether.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Export as a png sequence[/b] - this will be further expanded to export videos in the future. [/p][/*][/list][p]Using the new demo UI should feel familiar to anyone who worked with video editing applications before, however, we also tried to make it intuitive to new content creators by adding tooltips and keeping the UI fairly simple.[/p][p]This is the first iteration of the new demo UI, it's going to receive more features as time goes on based on both internal needs as well as community suggestions. With the new timeline and sandbox mode, we have a really solid foundation to add new tabs to the options panel in the future as well as new sandbox objects like entities. [/p][p]For now, the new UI is not enabled by default and requires `[b]demo.newui[/b]` to be set in the console. This is mostly to gather more feedback before we enable it by default in future updates. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW WORKSHOP SKINNABLE: SMALL BACKPACK[/h2][p][/p][p]This month’s workshop skinnable is the Small Backpack.[/p][p]Our first wearable in a while, the Small Backpack should be a great receptacle for some exciting skins! [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0311b1/03_10-21-KhakiNudibranch.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To make your own Small Backpack skin, head over to the in-game workshop and locate the Small Backpack deployable item. From there, you can download the model file and add your own materials.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]GAME STARTUP OPTIMISATIONS[/h2][p][/p][p]We've improved the startup loading times.[/p][p]Loading into the main menu was pulling in a lot of assets that weren't needed yet. It now only loads whats strictly required to reach the menu, with the rest streaming in the background. [/p][p]On most machines this should be about twice as fast.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SERVER PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p][/p][h2][b]Parallel Entity Saving on Jobs 4[/b][/h2][p]Currently [b]experimental[/b] [b]UsePlayerUpdateJobs 4[/b] mode is gaining a pretty important feature - fully parallel saving of entities, which should ease up one of the main bottlenecks in a server's frame processing.[/p][p]Back in Jobs 2 era I've introduced parallel snapshot sending. I only mentioned in passing on the blog, but the short version of what it does is:[/p][list][*][p]Build a dependency chain of snapshots (if we send both a parent and a child snapshot, then they gotta send in order as one chain)[/p][/*][*][p]Sort chains by ones having entities to serialize vs ones without[/p][/*][*][p]Former go to main thread, latter to worker threads[/p][/*][/list][p]Here's the most egregious example where this implementation struggled:[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b2911b1/KYU8OQIIS1.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The entire process took [b]5ms, [/b]where about [b]2.5ms[/b] was spent on building and sorting chains into task groups(the red square). Afterwards about 13 threads were helping send data while main thread spent another 2.5ms to serialize everything.[/p][p]There's no nice way to fix this, so we had to just support parallel saving if we wanted to improve things further. After making all save code thread safe, I simplified the logic - now snapshots get packaged up into batches(controlled by [b]ParallelNetworkQueueBatchSize, [/b]def 256), each batch is it's own task for thread pool.[/p][p]Our synthetic tests(256 batch size, no parenting, no caching) show following improvement:[/p][list][*][p]1000 entities: 6.6ms -> 3.6ms[/p][/*][*][p]10000 entities: 64.4ms -> 10.6ms[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b2911b1/rQ1JjvSiYX.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Pool, Take 2[/b][/h2][p]Back in [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/news/built-different#CorePerformanceImprovements"]June update[/url] we shipped a new pool that I called "FuzzyPool". It's fast, but it has a tendency to leak a small amount of objects during high contention. I got feedback from a bunch of community devs that it's a problem for them and they had to fall back to old mutex pool.[/p][p]So I rewrote it again - FuzzyPool is gone. This time instead of trying to invent it myself and have it be derpy I did some research and discovered [url="https://dl.acm.org/doi/epdf/10.1145/3572848.3577485"]LPRQ implementation[/url] by [i]Raed Romanov[/i] and [i]Nikita Koval[/i]. I repurposed one of it's internal mechanisms (PRQ) to make our pool better - it either matches FuzzyPool perf or exceeds it up to 20% in some scenarios, while also showing 0 leaks in high-contention scenarios.[/p][p]Bellow you can see some graphs - less is better:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mutex[/b] - our original implementation, omitted in most graphs as it breaks scale[/p][/*][*][p][b]FuzzyCB[/b] - current implementation of Pool[/p][/*][*][p][b]ConcQSegm[/b] - implementation based on CoreCLR's ConcurrentQueue shipped with unity's mscorlib[/p][/*][*][p][b]LPRQSegm[/b] - new implementation[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b2911b1/z18oSLN2Mm.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); flex-shrink: 1; height: 200px; min-width: 1%; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b2911b1/6AaqrvRbG8.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); flex-shrink: 1; height: 200px; min-width: 1%; display: block;"][/img][/p][p]If I don't hear about issues with it, then I'll rip out Mutex pool in the patch after this.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NOTABLE CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Maximum Rent[/b][/p][p]Maximum stored rent at the Apartment complex is now capped at 72 hours[/p][p][/p][p][b]Attachment Sounds[/b][/p][p]Audible range of equipping a weapon attachment has been reduced from 60m to 20m[/p][p][/p][p][b]Swing ragdolling[/b][/p][p]Players will ragdoll when dismounting the Apartment Complex swing set[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kayaks and Paddles[/b][/p][p]Fishing village now sells Kayaks and Paddles, rather than the blueprint of those items[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]VEHICLE EMOJIS[/h2][p][/p][p]In addition to regular and item emojis, all vehicles now have their own emoji available in the in-game chat.[/p][p]Along with that there have been some improvements to the emoji picker UI. Before you had to remember or guess the "short name" of the emoji you wanted to use, now it allows you to search for them by their name in your selected language.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0611b1/Aug2026_Vehicle_emojis_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SETFLAG DEPRECIATION[/h2][p][/p][p]For modders - we intend to remove SetFlag from the codebase with the September wipe (3rd Sep 26). This adds new CUI components, as well as a new feature and mechanic which allows server-side pie context menus.[/p][h2][b]New component: Tooltip[/b][/h2][p]This adds the ability to show a tooltip when hovering over any graphic element in your CUIs.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/raul/2026/August/tooltips.gif" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Component: Canvas Group[/b][/h2][p]Adds the ability to change graphic alpha, blocksRaycasts and interactable - this includes all child panels of the group component object.[/p][h2][b]New Component: Mask[/b][/h2][p]Adds the ability to mark an Image / RawImage as a mask, of which all child components will be masked by using the invisible alpha of the mask. [/p][h2][b]Image PPU (Pixels Per Unit)[/b][/h2][p]An issue which would block users from using the Image slice property was the lack of control over the PPU variables which has been exposed with this update under "ppuMultiplier".[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/raul/2026/August/04_14-27-YouthfulStickleback.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Mechanic: Custom Pie Menu[/b][/h2][p]This allows plugins to create a custom context menu from the server, which executes a command when an option is picked, or when the pie menu closes.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/raul/2026/August/custom_pie_menu.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Misc Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New RPC: CommunityEntity.DestroyUIs - takes a list of panel names to destroy at once[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: Button and Scrollbar color tweening / transition fade when it first gets created[/p][/*][*][p]Exposed: Button and InputField "interactable" individual property[/p][/*][*][p]Exposed: Individual graphics can now use "blocksRaycast" property[/p][/*][/list][p]All source code for the changes above are available on the [url="https://github.com/Facepunch/Rust.Community/commit/fc0b2be99c2ad340d581c29671f38492a20a2a53"]Rust.Community Github[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RUST OST ON VINYL[/h2][p][/p][p]The Rust Original Soundtrack is finally coming to vinyl.[/p][p]For the first time, Alex Rehberg's acclaimed score has been pressed onto a deluxe triple-LP.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0611b1/image%20%281%29.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]90 minutes of atmospheric ambient music that perfectly captures the tension, isolation and beauty of life on the island.[/p][p]The deluxe set is available to pre-order now, with full details on the pressing, artwork and release available [url="https://lnk.to/rust-vinyl"]here[/url].[/p]

newsitems.title: Facepunch director Alistair McFarlane, who once offered to buy New World from Amazon and faked us out about Rust 2, has left the company
newsitems.author: Andy Chalk
newsitems.contents: listair McFarlane, chief operating officer and director of Facepunch Studios, has left the company. McFarlane said in a message posted on X that July 30 was his last day at the studio, bringing to an end an 11 year career that began with a QA role and led him to become the executive producer on Rust, and often the public face of the studio... Read more.

newsitems.title: Rust's Common Ground update lets you set up clans, a shop, or kick back in your apartment
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
The July update for Rust, 'Common Ground' is finally here, bringing with it a set of patch notes and a huge amount of new features. Now, Facepunch is looking to its Monuments, adding two brand new ones: The Apartment Complex, which lets you rent rooms when getting started with a wipe, and Rentable Shops to sell items to other players.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Rust's Common Ground update lets you set up clans, a shop, or kick back in your apartment

newsitems.title: COMMON GROUND
newsitems.author: Errn
newsitems.contents:
[p][/p][h2]APARTMENT COMPLEX[/h2][p][/p][p]The apartment complex is a new monument that allows players getting started with a wipe to find a place to call home. Simply talk to the receptionist in the lobby to get started and rent a room.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_apartment_complex_1080-7.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/102/07/2026/7f63/rust_apartment_complex_1080-14.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 367px; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/102/07/2026/4k84/rust_apartment_complex_1080-15.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 367px; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][/p][p]There are options for every budget, from the basement to the penthouse. Different room types come with different perks, like more storage, furnaces and more.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/july2026_apartment_hallways_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Once you've rented a room you'll need to insert scrap into the slot next to your door, otherwise you'll be evicted and all of your possessions will be seized.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/july2026_apartmentmedium_01%20%281%29.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]There is a master key available somewhere on the island - find it and you can unlock access to any occupied room in the apartments for 5 minutes.[/p][p] 
Need a hint as to what room to burgle? There might be a guard in the basement who has more information.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RENTABLE SHOPS[/h2][p][/p][p]The new apartment complex monument features a small marketplace of shops. Each shop can be purchased and run by players, allowing you to sell your wares to the residents of the apartment building.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/rust_market_8_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To get started, simply approach the shop and interact with the contract hanging out front, and you'll get a breakdown of how much it costs. This includes a non-refundable upfront scrap fee as well as a per-hour (real-time) scrap cost. You will need at least 12 hours of rent available to open the store.[/p][p]Once open, you can modify the sale listings and adjust stock levels like any other Vending Machine. These shops cannot be accessed by drone, but you can modify the sign above the shop to add some personal flair.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b3011b1/rust_market_UI_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]All of the shops already taken? After a shop has been open for 6 hours, you may take it over, but you will pay x2 on both the upfront scrap cost and per-hour rent. This will continue to escalate (3x, 4x, etc) if someone else takes over the shop after 6 hours until eventually someone runs out of rent and the shop (and cost multiplier) resets.[/p][p]If a shop is taken over or closes and it has your belongings in its inventory, you may return to the shop to retrieve them. Just interact with the shop to pick up your items. These items will only last 24 hours though, so be quick![/p][p]Be warned, the master key can also be used on these stores so your items could be stolen if you try and store valuable goods.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SOFTCORE UPDATES[/h2][p][/p][p]We've made some new changes to the Softcore game mode. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Accelerated Progression[/b][/h3][p]There's now a [b]2x multiplier[/b] on resource gather amounts. This works pretty much as you'd be used to on modded servers, giving you extra ore, wood, food and animal loot. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ianhenderson/1b0211b1/july2026_softcore_treecut_02.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h3][b]Raid Windows[/b][/h3][p]It's hard to handle raids for more casual players. To combat this, we've created pre-defined time windows where you are allowed to raid each other. By default, raids can only happen between the hours of [b]6 PM - 9 PM[/b]. This is set via your server's local time, so it's the same time zone for everyone. E.g. 6 PM local time no matter where you are. During a Raid Window, everything is fair game, it's regular rust.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/rust_softcore_raiding_UI_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Outside of those times, Tool Cupboards 'project' the raid blocking system, so you need to be inside a TC radius to be protected outside of the window. During this time, building blocks and doors cannot be raided: walls, floors, roofs, doors, ladder hatches, etc. Deployables can still be attacked, as can a Tool Cupboard (if it's lying unprotected).
[/p][p]A Tool Cupboard must be at least 1 hour old to be able to block raids. This means a young TC can be raided regardless of whether the raid window is on or not. Helping prevent misuse of the system.[/p][p]Server Owners have been given a bunch of ConVars to tweak this.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]CLAN TABLE[/h2][p][/p][p]Clans are a more advanced version of teams where you can have more members with different roles/permissions. There is a separate clan chat channel and announcement/MoTD text for communicating with clan members.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/102/07/2026/6V08/rust_clan_table_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Clans can be created and managed at Clan Tables.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/102/07/2026/8T27/rust_clan_table_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]You can now see clan names on player nameplates. You'll also see your clan members' locations on the map if they're nearby.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/102/07/2026/3363/rust_clan_UI_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The clan system is disabled in hardcore mode.[/p][p][/p][h2]
PLAYER ANIMATION - SPRINTING WITH RIFLES[/h2][p][/p][p]As mentioned last month, we're starting to use a [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/news/built-different#Improvedanimationsystems"]new set of animation tools[/url] to improve the player animator. This month we're rolling out new sprinting animations while holding most two handed projectile weapons/rifles. [/p][p]The player now pops their right arm up and lets the sprinting animation take over the rest of the body, looking much more responsive and less robotic.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]PLAYER ANIMATION -ONE HANDED MELEE WEAPONS[/h2][p][/p][p]We've extended last month's Torch animation system to support one handed melee weapons. We're just testing this out on the vanilla Hatchet for now, but once we're happy with the results we'll roll this out to other melee weapons. This allows for nicer movement while holding a weapon while still allowing two handed animations like throwing to play as expected.
[/p][p][/p][h2]GLOWING WALLPAPER PACK[/h2][p][/p][p]This month, we’re introducing the Glowing Wallpaper Pack. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/Jul2026_Glowing_Wallpaper_DLC_Hero_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Brighten up your base with this collection of 27 wall, floor, and ceiling wallpapers. Featuring luminous neon, glowing graffiti, foxfire fungi, and more. Whether you’re building the coziest crib or an industrial powerhouse, this pack has something for everyone.   [/p][p]These wallpapers look great in the day, but are even more special when the lights go out.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/glowing_wallpaper_pack_blog_08b.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); min-width: 100%; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/glowing_wallpaper_pack_blog_02.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); min-width: 100%; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/glowing_wallpaper_pack_blog_04.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); min-width: 100%; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/glowing_wallpaper_pack_blog_05.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); min-width: 100%; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/glowing_wallpaper_pack_blog_07b.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); min-width: 100%; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/glowing_wallpaper_pack_blog_06b.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); min-width: 100%; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][/p][p]Included in the Glowing Wallpaper Pack:[/p][p]Walls[/p][list][*][p]Stars And Planets[/p][/*][*][p]Mushrooms [/p][/*][*][p]Firearms[/p][/*][*][p]Explosions[/p][/*][*][p]Graffiti Murals (3 variants)[/p][/*][*][p]Neon Shapes (3 variants)[/p][/*][*][p]Foxfire Fungi[/p][/*][/list][p]Ceilings[/p][list][*][p]Glow In The Dark Stars[/p][/*][*][p]Fireflies[/p][/*][*][p]Graffiti Murals (4 variants)[/p][/*][*][p]Foxfire Fungi[/p][/*][/list][p]Floors[/p][list][*][p]Directional Graffiti (6 variants)[/p][/*][*][p]Glow In The Dark Carpet (3 variants)[/p][/*][/list][p]The Glowing Wallpaper Pack can be purchased in-game or from the [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/store/pack/glowingwallpaperpack"]Rust Steam item store[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]USEPLAYERJOBS CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Jobs 3 is now default, Jobs 2 to be removed[/b][/h3][p]This month we've added a couple more changes/improvements to [b]Jobs 3[/b] code and we've had the it active on our servers for half of the month and things looked stable. We've also done a bit of a rewrite how we pass around server player state, which will force server mods to update their code as well. This makes it the perfect time for us to promote it to default, as it would enable us to clean up a bit more code and simplify things.[/p][p]This means [b]Jobs 2 [/b]mode will become deprecated and will be removed in August - one will still be able to set it to 2, but it will run mode 3 underneath.[/p][p]As Jobs 3 has been modified over multiple months, here's the full list of improvements that comes with it:[/p][list][*][p]Use of UniTask library to avoid allocations from multithreading code[/p][/*][*][p]Speeds up per frame player snapshot sending by using new fuzzy pool and removing buffer preallocation[/p][/*][*][p]Runs portions of player network subscription updates in parallel[/p][/*][*][p]Schedules EAC and Analytics tasks earlier to avoid main thread waiting on them[/p][/*][*][p]Parallelized remaining server Anti Hack logic[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b0111b1/paintdotnet_MmM7jy94Uc.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 183.5px; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b0111b1/msedge_lV0AukOR2u.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 183.5px; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b0111b1/paintdotnet_Loobakh4Mx.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 183.5px; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b0111b1/paintdotnet_HvJuMT4H8w.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-height: 250px; max-width: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center center; flex-grow: 1; margin: 16px auto; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); width: 183.5px; height: 150px; display: block;"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Jobs 4 level[/b][/h3][p]We've also started to explore [b]Jobs 4[/b] optimizations - our first contribution to it is parallelization of server occlusion pair gathering. We're also going to be looking what kind of more risky or breaking changes to make, so it'll likely be a couple months before Jobs 4 will have enough substance to ship it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NOTABLE CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Picked Skin Grey Out[/b][/p][p]Picked Skin is now Greyed Out[/p][p][b]Auto Sorted[/b][/p][p]Vending machines and fridges now support storage adaptor auto-sorting[/p][p][b]Inventory Player Model[/b][/p][p]Player model quality now changes within the inventory to yield better performance[/p][p][b]Footstep Frequency[/b][/p][p]Adjusted the footstep frequency to be closer to the old player rig[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BEARS FOR A BETTER WORLD - CHARITY 2026[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to cuddle up with a bear that’s not only adorable but also changing lives!
Starting July 2nd, Rust will host a massive charity drive to raise money for two incredible causes: [url="https://www.cancerresearchuk.org/get-involved"]Cancer Research UK[/url] and [url="https://ronaldmcdonaldhouse.org.uk/"]Ronald McDonald House UK[/url].

Rust is also partnering with some of the biggest names in the Rust community! Throughout the drive, partnered creators will be hosting their own fundraising streams, with free Twitch Drops to also help raise awareness of the charities and allow players to show even more support.[/p][p]We even have a [url="https://tiltify.com/@facepunch/auctions/plushie-bear-campaign"]Charity Auction[/url]! Want a signed Displate poster?  Or to design your own Rust Skin?  Go check it out![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b2911b1/rust_charity_plushies_smallgroup_4_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]100% of sale proceeds after Steam fees and tax from the sale of these charity bears will be donated, helping support Cancer Research UK's critical work in funding cancer research and saving lives, and also supporting Ronald McDonald House UK to provide free accommodation and support to families with children in hospital. Every purchase will make a difference.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b1811b1/rust_charity_plushies_cancer_1_4k.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]These one-of-a-kind charity bears are available through Rust’s in-game item store, and players can choose from two cute, quirky, and (actually) glowing but true-to-Rust designs which represent your contribution to supporting families in need and funding groundbreaking cancer research. Every bear purchased is a symbol of the community coming together to create a lasting impact beyond the game. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b1811b1/rust_charity_plushies_ronald_hazzy_hold_4k.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Starting July 2nd, players can purchase these bears, but the clock is ticking as they are only available for a limited time.[/p][p]
Whether you’re surviving the wilds of Rust or just want to spread some good vibes in your base, these bears are a perfect way to help others while you play.[/p][p]Charity Bear Plushies can be bought [url="https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/252490/"]here[/url]![/p][p]
You can donate directly to the charities through Rust's drive [url="https://twitch.facepunch.com/"]here[/url].[/p][p]
And you can see creators and drive progress [url="https://tiltify.com/tif/facepunch-studios"]here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Twitch Drops! [/b][/h2][p]Also starting July 2nd - we will have 5 drops you can earn watching any Rust stream on Twitch![/p][p][url="https://twitch.facepunch.com/"][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Errn/1b0111b1/Rust%20x%20Bears%20for%20a%20Better%20World%20-%20Values.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);"][/img][/url][/p][p]Over the course of the next few weeks you can help unlock more drops as we meet donation goal milestones![/p][p]Sync your Steam and Twitch accounts to claim your drops! [/p][p][url="https://twitch.facepunch.com/"]https://twitch.facepunch.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you're a content creator or a community group and you want to help fundraise with us you can make your own Tiltify team [url="https://start.tiltify.com/?supportingFactId=5cf75471-1792-483e-a0d0-65cd1da57dd8"]here[/url]!  Just select the Quick start option and publish your team page!  Your teams progress will go towards the main campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]DEMO COMPATIBILITY LAYER[/h2][p][/p][p]Every Rust update has the ability to break older demos. On our end its incredibly simple to do so, more than it should be. To this end: I've introduced a compatibility layer into the demo system. This layer will try and get old demos working on your new Rust version. [/p][p][/p][p]When opening an old demo you will be asked if you want to use the compatibility layer (should it be applicable). When enabled the layer will attempt to remap changed item names to what they used to be in order to get the demo to run. It's important to note that this is only likely to work provided the demo has been taken within the last few months, the older it is, the less likely it is to work.[/p][p][/p][p]The one catch is that this system wont work for demos taken on older Rust builds than now. Eg: this layer only works for demos taken from now onwards. Demos taken on older builds of rust don't have the information required to be able to turn on this layer[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW WORKSHOP SKINNABLE: METAL SHOP FRONT[/h2][p][/p][p]This month’s workshop skinnable is the Metal Shopfront.[/p][p]Supporting customisation on both the front and back, you can finally sell your collection of severed wolf heads on brand. We’re looking forward to seeing some incredible submissions by the community. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/kaantasan/1b0111b1/Jul2026_Skinnable_Metal_Shopfront_4_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To make your own Metal Shopfront skin, head over to the in-game workshop and locate the Metal Shopfront deployable item. From there, you can download the model file and add your own materials.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RUST X CAN BE - BACKPACK AND WEAPON CHARMS[/h2][p][/p][p]The Rust x Can Be backpack will begin shipping this month.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/lewis/1b3011b1/Rust%20x%20Canbe%20Backpack.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Every backpack purchase includes exclusive free in-game weapon charms.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What are Weapon charms?[/b][/h2][p]Weapon Charms are fun cosmetic weapon accessories that can be attached to almost any ranged weapon. There are over 55 ranged weapons that currently support Charms with more to be added as we continue to develop Rust. [/p][p]To add a charm to your ranged weapon simply open up the inventory, select the weapon and use the Change Accessory button to select from available charms. You can set the charm during the crafting phase, or when dropped into a repair bench. There is no crafting cost. You can even do this with looted ranged weapons that have charms already affixed. The selected charm is tied to the individual weapon, so if you pick up someone else's weapon with a charm attached it will still be there unless you remove or change it.  [/p][p]Weapon Charms are viewable both in first and third person, so other players will be able to see your selected accessory. [/p][p]Check out the full collection over on the Can Be [url="https://can.be/collabs/rust-x-can-be"]store[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RUST X MAN AT ARMS - IRL AUTO TURRET[/h2][p][/p][p]We've teamed up with the talented ASH Entertainment and The Baltimore Knife & Sword Crew behind the YouTube series, Man at Arms, to bring to life one of Rust's most iconic items: the Auto Turret. [/p][previewyoutube="ffOj11WXj8Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The team of expert fabricators and blacksmiths set out to recreate a 1:1 replication of the infamous base and safezone protecting Turret, with auto-tracking and a bespoke gun slot with firing mechanisms![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b1811b1/ManAtArms_Rust_AutoTurret_Preview-2.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; newsitems.title: Rust is having a Face Off moment with its new update, introducing new and improved character models
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
The Rust 'Built Different' update has just landed, bringing with it the most substantial upgrade to its player models in years. Sporting fresh animations to boot, characters are far more realistic, though I always found their kinetic jank to be part of the Rust experience. Alongside the revamp, Facepunch has brought a new top-tier armor set and a classic assault rifle to the fore.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: Rust is having a Face Off moment with its new update, introducing new and improved character models

This time, in things that video games are doing, is brought to you by Rust, as it's received an update that gives the player character model a bit of a glow-up.
