newsitems.title: Everyone in Rust is getting a new face
newsitems.author: Christopher Livingston
newsitems.contents: Rust's character customization options have always been a bit unusual in that… well, you don't get any. Your character's looks are generated by a random seed and you don't have any say over them. Whatever you get, you get, from face to race to gender to the size of your dong or boobs... Read more.

newsitems.title: BUILT DIFFERENT
newsitems.author: Frog Hag
newsitems.contents:
[h1]PLAYER UPDATE[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]New Player Model[/b][/h2][p]We’ve overhauled the player model from the ground up.[/p][p]This includes improved meshes and materials, more realistic proportions on a new rig, expanded head and hair seeds and a much needed pass over almost everything player-related.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5377070/8578b78d634e17a0b04141e1b60161f1d95f03a9.png"][/img]The old player model has served us well for almost 10 years, but it’s lagged behind the rest of the game for some time. Visually, it was showing its age, but just as importantly it was holding us back from making bigger improvements to characters, animations and implementing future features. Prior attempts to improve the player model has always ended up feeling like band-aid fix, there was only so much we could do while working around the limitations of the old proportions and skeleton. At some point it became clear that the only real way forward was to rip it out and rebuild it properly.[/p][p]Alongside the new base model, we’ve also:[/p][list][*][p]Expanded the number of heads in the game, with each head now having unique materials and additional details such as eyelashes and improved eye lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and expanded hairstyles and beards, using new anisotropic shaders to make hair feel more natural.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated all clothing to work with the new rig and proportions, giving a lot of older assets a much-needed refresh and fixing some long-standing issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Modernised the art pipeline behind the player model, making future fixes and improvements much easier to ship.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5377070/a703220b06fc8df4a271d95e543ddffcf567d98a.jpg"][/img]Your face will change, but race and gender seeds have been kept intact, so we’re hoping it won’t be too much of a shock for those of you who have grown attached to your random seed over the years. We’ll be continuing to improve on the player model after release, and we also have a player customisation update planned for the future.[/p][p]It’s been a huge amount of work, especially as we’ve been doing it alongside regular development and monthly updates. Performing open-heart surgery on one of the most interconnected parts of Rust, while continuing to ship patches, has certainly come with its challenges.[/p][h2][b]Performance[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We know “improved visuals” and “additional details” can be worrying to hear when it comes to performance. It’s something we’ve been watching closely throughout development. Alongside the visual improvements, we’ve also done a deeper pass on our tooling and pipelines, which has allowed us to make optimisations we couldn’t make with the old setup.[/p][p align="start"]Our internal metrics are looking positive so far, and we’ll continue to monitor performance closely after release.[/p][p][/p][h1]BALLISTIC ARMOUR[/h1][p][/p][p]For the first time in a very long time, we're adding a new top-tier armour set to Rust.[/p][p]The Ballistic Armour set offers increased protection over existing craftable alternatives, but there's a catch. It cannot be crafted. If you want your hands on it, you'll need to find it. This armour is comparable to existing metal armour with plates. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0311b1/Jun2026_BDU_Ballistic_Armour_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]We're also introducing the Battle Dress Uniform (BDU). Like the Ballistic Armour, the BDU is loot-only and cannot be crafted. It offers slightly improved protection over existing clothing options, while making a few trade-offs elsewhere.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0311b1/Jun2026_BDU_Ballistic_Armour_2_1080%20%281%29.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Both sets are intended to expand late-game gear progression and create more valuable loot opportunities. If you're looking for the best equipment available, you'll need to get out there and fight for it.[/p][p][/p][h1]NEW WEAPON: M16A2[/h1][p][/p][p]The M16A2 is a military-grade rifle found through end-end loot and cannot be crafted. Designed around a three-round burst fire mode, it offers excellent accuracy and a high rate of fire, making it particularly effective at medium-range engagements.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/103/06/2026/1685/june2026_m16a2_04.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To help balance the burst damage potential, the M16A2 deals less damage per shot compared to the LR-300.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/103/06/2026/9Q64/june2026_m16a2_05.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Like the Ballistic Armour and BDU, the M16A2 is another valuable loot-only item you'll need to get out into the world and fight for. You'll see a theme here. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]PSA: PERFORMANCE ISSUE WITH HIGH POLLING RATE[/h1][p][/p][p]The Unity 6 update changed how mouse inputs are processed. High polling rate mice (1000Hz+) are now causing significant CPU overhead issues and frame drops.[/p][p][b]Lower your mouse polling rate [/b]to <1000Hz via your mouse manufacturerer's software. (Logitech G HUB, SteelSeries GG, etc..)[/p][p]We're looking into a proper fix on our end. Sorry for the hassle.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]IMPROVED ANIMATION SYSTEMS[/h1][p][/p][p]One of the primary goals of the new player model was to give us a better foundation to improve the player animations in Rust. We're now starting to improve our animation systems to allow us to make the player animator feel less robotic and more life like.[/p][p]One key problem we've faced in the past is that all of the animations that the player uses are in a single monolithic animation state machine. This is over 250+ animations, along with override sets for most weapons. This state machine is painful and error prone to update since every weapon and mountable shares it - changing how an animation transitions could have unpredictable consequences for other situations in the game.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/15_11-32-BriefAmericancicada/Unity_rHiSrev9ws.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To resolve this we've built a new sub system tool that lets us layer in additional, bespoke animation logic in certain situations in the game. Instead of extending and adding even more animations into our massive animator controller, we can now create small self-contained new animation behaviours and apply them in specific contexts. [/p][p]That's all a bit dense, so let's look at a real world example - the humble torch. We all start with one, and we've all turned it on at night and immediately been killed. It's suffered from a few animation issues that were challenging to solve in the past. Even though it's only held in the right hand, our animation system could only take over the whole upper body, so the left arm was always stiff and robotic. The upper body animator had no awareness of the players locomotion, so it couldn't react to running, jumping, etc (and even if it was aware, making a whole set of running and jumping animations just for the torch is wasteful).[/p][p]To solve this we've applied a new sub system that creates a new state machine just applied to the right arm. This preserves the running and moving animations on the left arm. We've also added support to blend in the left arm during animations that require it - lighting the torch for instance.[/p][p]We've just rolling this out in a few small places for now to test it out and make sure it's stable, but these new tools are going to allow us to work faster, produce less animation bugs and get a better looking result going forwards.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]ANIMATIONS UPDATE[/h1][p][/p][p][b]Animation matching[/b][/p][p]Where possible, we have taken this opportunity to match 3p animations with what happens in the viewmodel. Many of the old animations were wildly different, both in actions and timing.[/p][p]
[b]More bespoke anims[/b]
Some weapons shared anims due to time constraints but weren't always a great fit.  There are now more bespoke anims created specifically for each weapon.[/p][p][b]3/4 stance[/b][/p][p]The original goal was to move on from forward-facing aiming which, although functional looks awful visually. It also makes clipping of elements like the stock inevitable because the upper body can’t ‘make space’ for the weapon which must aim true.
[/p][p]We've gone with more of a weaver stance in this update, to reduce some of the issues listed above.
[/p][p]It's a more natural looking stance, importantly with more twist in the body and angled hips.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]INDUSTRIAL DECOR PACK[/h1][p][/p][p]Straight from the forge this month is the Industrial Decor Pack, a collection of 20 heavy-duty and machined industrial themed items to galvanize your base. Featuring decorative deployables, utilitarian storage and sturdy tools. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0211b1/june2026_industrialDLC_heroimage_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Shipping in the in-game store or from the [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/store/pack/industrialdecor"]Rust Steam item store[/url][/p][h2][b]Industrial Shelving[/b][/h2][p]To go alongside the shelving, we’re also shipping the Industrial Storage Barrels in both horizontal and vertical varieties. Made from steel and probably several hazardous chemicals, they’re sure to keep your precious loot safe, or toxic, and safe. You can change their colour with the Spray Can tool. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2911b1/june2026_DLC_industrialwallshelf_02.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2911b1/june2026_DLC_industrialshelving_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Industrial Storage Barrels[/b][/h2][p]To go alongside the shelving, we’re also shipping the Industrial Storage Barrels in both horizontal and vertical varieties. Made from steel and probably several hazardous chemicals, they’re sure to keep your precious loot safe, or toxic, and safe.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/june2026_DLC_industrialstorage_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Industrial Torch[/b][/h2][p]Light-up the path ahead with this skin for the Torch, featuring an electric filament and unique animations.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0211b1/june2026_industrial_decor_DLC_Torch_1_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Industrial Auto Turret[/b][/h2][p]Light-up the competition with the Industrial Auto Turret. Made from the toughest metal framework, this skin for the Auto Turret is sure to deal with any intruders definitively.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/june2026_DLC_industrialautoturret_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Industrial Large Furnace[/b][/h2][p]Start an industrial revolution with this unique and exclusive skin for the Large Furnace. Go from primitive to the modern era with this one-stop shop to progress.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/june2026_DLC_industriallargefurnace_01.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Industrial Electric Furnace[/b][/h2][p]Seize the means of production with this skin for the Electric Furnace. Looking like a basement nuclear reactor, you’ll be sure to blitz through any safety guidelines in your charge for more ore.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2911b1/june2026_DLC_industrialelectricfurance_04.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Industrial Garage Door[/b][/h2][p]Roll up the shutters and get to work. Featuring a unique animation and plexiglass windows for extra security, this skin for the Garage Door is sure to get things done.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/june2026_DLC_industrialgaragedoor_03.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Painted Concrete Floor Wallpapers[/b][/h2][p]Featuring 6 unique flooring wallpapers, you can create virtually any layout you wish with these floor designs. From production-line to dead-end trap.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2911b1/june2026_DLC_industrialconcretefloor_01.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Industrial Sprays and Emojis[/b][/h2][p]Theme up your base, or just trash-talk your rivals, these sprays and emojis are sure to put in a shift.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/rust_industrial_dlc_sprays_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]BOWLESS CROSSBOW[/h1][p][/p][p]This month we’re introducing the Bowless Crossbow which is a unique skin for the Crossbow. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b0111b1/june2026_industrial_bowless_crossbow_DLC_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]Clearly made by someone with a grudge and a hefty disregard for health and safety. Made from salvaged workshop components and featuring a bowless pulley system, this crossbow is sure to pack a punch.[/p][p]
The Bowless Crossbow can be purchased in-game or from the [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/store/weapon/bowlesscrossbow"]Rust Steam item store[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]SKIN VIEWER[/h1][p][/p][p]The skin viewer got a small upgrade this month. You can now inspect skins in your hand, straight from the store or your Steam inventory menu.[/p][p][/p][h1]IMPROVED HIT VALIDATION[/h1][p][/p][p]Often, you can land shots on players in hot air balloons or on boats and you’ll be met with the dreaded ‘projectile invalid’. This is because the server has rejected your hit.[/p][p]This month, I looked at improving hit validation for parented players. Hit validation now takes into consideration the previous position of parents when validation happens - this should let your shots land and provide a better experience for players all around.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]DISCORD X RUST - THE WUMPUS PLUSH[/h1][p][/p][p]We are excited to announce a very special, first-of-its-kind collaboration with our friends over at [b]Discord[/b]. Starting today, you can bring Discord’s iconic mascot, [b]Wumpus[/b], out of your chats and straight into your base!

Say hello to the [b]In-Game Wumpus Plush[/b].[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0311b1/rust_wumpus_2_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The Wumpus Plush is a one time exception and is exclusive to the Discord Shop.
[/p][p]To grab them, you'll need to purchase him directly through Discord, which will then link up and unlock the item on your Steam account inventory.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0311b1/rust_wumpus_3_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The Wumpus Plushie can be placed anywhere inside your base. Stick them on your workbench, line a few up on your roof to confuse raiders, or just keep them next to your sleeping bag for [b]70% comfort[/b], and good luck before a big Deep Sea run.  

[b]Deployable Companion:[/b] Fully interactive placement - rotate, stack, and find the perfect spot for your new friend and receive 70% comfort when near them.  

[b]Discord Authenticity:[/b] Lovingly modeled to bring Discord's signature colours and aesthetic, seamlessly into Rust's universe.

[b]100% Flex:[/b] Show the friends and foes you were there for Rust's first-ever Discord store collab.[/p][p]Head on over to the [url="https://discord.com/channels/560127830160048128/game-shop/0/1511661245592240296/wumpus-plush"]Rust Game Shop on Discord[/url] to get yours![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]CORE PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Pool Rewrite[/b][/h2][p]We rely on an internal utility called Pool to recycle objects and avoid allocations - it's vital for avoiding creating pressure on the Garbage Collector. Since it's vital, it's used everywhere throughout our codebase.[/p][p]Couple months ago I've discovered that it becomes a bottleneck when trying to introduce multithreaded batch processing of work(example: sending entity snapshots to players every frame). To provide basic thread-race safety, it's implemented with the use of a mutex, and in hot-ish loops there can be a lot of contention on that mutex, slowing all worker threads down.[/p][p]After some experimentation with different implementations, I've settled on a slightly-fuzzy lock-free design([b]FuzzyCB[/b] bellow) that is competitive with ConcurrentBag in single thread performance and Single-Producer-Single-Consumer threading scenarios, but beats it in Multi-Producer-Single-Consumer scenario:[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danielprihodko/1b0211b1/QcO6T2Ceds.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]As it's "fuzzy", it has a drawback - it never knows exactly how many objects are in the pool. As a result, when there's high contention on the pool and it's close to capacity, it can start to sporadically spill objects. The rate of spill is small - in one test of recycling 32k objects from 32 threads it spilled ~0.15%, or 48 objects.[/p][p]It's now active throughout the codebase and I'm relying on it in UsePlayerUpdateJobs 3 to skip object preallocation. If it causes an issue for servers or clients, you can roll back to using original Pool implementation using [b]pool.usemutexpool 1[/b] command. Once new pool is confirmed stable, I'll remove the fallback option.[/p][h2][b]More StringViews[/b][/h2][p]As part of the effort to clean-up various miscellaneous allocations, I've replaced parts of console commands system to work using [b]StringView[/b],[b] [/b]specifically parsing and storing of incoming commands and their arguments. Most of the interface exposes arguments as StringViews with usual conversion APIs, but if there are mods that do their own fancy arg processing via strings, I've left a compatibility GetString call.[/p][p]Although changing API is disruptive to server mods, this rewrite allowed us to get rid of 60+ allocations/4KB+ when invoking a command with 6 arguments, so it's worthwhile for me to pursue. To make the transition a bit less painful, I'm keeping StringView similar to both String and ReadOnlySpan APIs. Over the next couple months I'll be continuing it's propagation and smoothing out various kinks with it's design.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]UNDER THE HOOD[/h1][p][/p][p]What do we gain under the hood for these player improvements?
[/p][p][b]Animation rig[/b][/p][p]By freeing ourselves up to create a new rig we have been able to nail more realistic proportions. We've also been able to select a more natural bind pose, allowing character art to sculpt more realistic models suitable for deformation.[/p][p][/p][p]We've been able to burn the 12-year-old Maya rig with fire and create a much more robust, powerful control rig for the animation team that's also future-proof. The skeleton itself includes helper twist bones and metacarpals that, even though we can't take full advantage of yet in Unity, are in the roadmap as our end goal.[/p][p][/p][p]The all new control rig now includes:[/p][p]- ik/fk spine[/p][p]- full body fk/ik/matching and switching[/p][p]- customisable selection sets[/p][p]- pose library[/p][p]- space creation[/p][p]- rig guide setup for easy re-generation and updating[/p][p]- rig publishing[/p][p]- referencing features for easily updating meshes mid-process[/p][p]- communication with Maya's HIK system[/p][p]- drag and drop mocap application[/p][p][/p][p]This rig essentially means creating 3p animation is now a more pleasant experience for us, and we can create higher-quality output.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Animation x character art[/b][/p][p]Working with this new Maya rig also means collaboration with the character art team (also in Maya) has become much more symbiotic. The current workflow for character art clothing involves creating a beautiful model and then having to mutilate and distort the proportions to fit the existing model. This step will now finally be removed and clothing can be seen as intended in all it's glory. All clothing assets can now all be directly loaded into Maya, with search tool functions & easy exporting so the character & animation teams can work directly on the same source files.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Entity updates[/b][/p][p]Many weapons were set up with hacky Unity offsets at a time when we didn't have a prop bone to attach to.  We've now taken this opportunity to attach all weapons to a prop bone directly and remove those offsets.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Animation Logic[/b][/p][p]This remains mostly unchanged.  We have seen from recent games that have attempted similar updates that ultimately in a game like Rust, you demand instant response time, not silky transitions between every action. While as an animator this stuff is lovely to see....generally, the player base on those other titles has seen such additions as an annoyance and has been received poorly.[/p][p]You'll be happy to know the player update is just as snappy/responsive as the current version, so if you still get killed it's all on you.  We hope to add nicer touches in the future (one such feature is explained in Jarryd's subsystem section) but any changes will be measured with the overall current players experience of Rust in mind. They also will be introduced organically, and not in one huge update that shocks the system.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]NEW NAVMESH[/h1][p][/p][p align="start"]This month, we are taking our first step towards [b]replacing Unity’s navmesh[/b] with our own.

Admins can enable the new navmesh by using “-useNewNavmesh" as a starting argument on server start, it will be disabled by default for now. You can then visualize the navmesh is game with "rustNav.draw".

This opens lots of opportunities for improving npc performance and fixing long standing bugs.
Here is what players can expect in the future:[/p][list][*][p]Animals and scientists will be able to enter and move in player bases. For now they can only enter a simple base with no door when the new navmesh is enabled. This is part of the groundwork for keeping sheep, cows, dogs.[/p][/*][*][p]New animals dying randomly happens less (it happened because of unity failing to path on some convex or concave terrain).[/p][/*][*][p]We’ll be able to update the scientist AI on cargo and excavator (which was not possible before because we needed a moving navmesh).[/p][/*][*][p]New scientists will have better and cheaper flanking (through a custom A* cost that de-incentivizes direct paths).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Performance wise:[/p][list][*][p]Navmesh is built in the background after the server starts, but on restarts it will be loaded from disk which is instant.[/p][/*][*][p]The obstacles like player foundations are handled on other threads +
budgeted, and don’t impact the framerate (unity’s way of handling
obstacles has a significant constant performance overhead).[/p][/*][*][p]We limit the max time a single pathfinding query is allowed to take, so a single npc can’t create a lag spike with a long path request.[/p][/*][*][p]When looking for cover or peeks, new scientists will be able to quickly discard positions they can’t reach without needing expensive pathfinding queries.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Unity, and lots of other game engines like Unreal or Godot, internally uses a third party pathfinding library called [b]Recast[/b].[/p][p align="start"]We still use the same library, the difference is that we now have full control over it, and we’re not limited by Unity’s black-box integration.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]PREMIUM ACCESS[/h1][h1][/h1][p]We're renaming [b]Premium[/b] to [b]Premium Access Pass[/b].[/p][p]This is simply a rebrand, there are no functional changes. If your Steam inventory value is $15 or more, you'll continue to have access to Premium Access servers exactly as before.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0211b1/Rust%20x%20Premium%20Access%2016x9_compressed.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]This change is part of some longer-term groundwork for future monetisation (boo) plans. We've no plans to change how premium works, as we've talked about in prior blogs, it's doing a decent job at gating cheaters. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Alistair/103/06/2026/9C93/rust_premium_access_rebrand_4_1080.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]The Rust Premium name will be revived for a new monetisation system we're looking to implement late this year. It's not a battle pass, nor a VIP system, but more of a monthly opt-in for additional skins/perks. We're finalising details of exactly how this system will work. We'll share details ahead of launch for you all to tell us how bad it is, looking at you, Reddit. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]NEW WORKSHOP SKINNABLE: AUTO TURRET[/h1][p][/p][p]This month’s workshop skinnable is the Auto Turret.

A constant companion to many a Rust base, this little guy is ready to receive some love from the skinning community. Just make sure it’s not hostile when painting the business end.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/rust_autoturret_1080_2.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]To make your own Auto Turret skin, head over to the in-game workshop and locate the Auto Turret deployable item. From there, you can download the model file and add your own materials.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]KICK OFF 2 - DROPS![/h1][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Drops on Kick are back![/b][/h2][p]
This June sees Kick bring their unique green back to the biggest survival game on Steam as they play host to Kick Off 2. And from [b]June 11th - June 21st, [/b]players can earn up to 10 captain/co-captiain exclusives, a Garage Door, and a Locker skin, as well as a unique Kick Wallpaper, just by watching the action-packed PvP event![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0211b1/KICK-Round-3-blog-image.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p][b]Event/Broadcast/Drops start:[/b] June 11th 4PM EDT / 9PM BST / 8PM UTC 
[b]Kick broadcast exclusive skin:[/b] June 11th-14th (15th UTC)
[b]Drops end:[/b] June 21st 7PM EDT / Midnight BST / 11PM UTC

As usual, don't forget to sync your accounts here - [/p][p][url="https://kick.facepunch.com/"]https://kick.facepunch.com/[/url]

And [url="https://kick.com/category/rust"]tune in[/url] for another chaotic PvP competition while getting your hands on these unique Drops![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]YOUTOOZ FURNACE NIGHT LIGHT[/h1][p][/p][p]We've launched a Furnace Night Light with long time merch partners, Youtooz! [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0311b1/rust-nightlight_livenow_square.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);"][/img][/p][p]The new Furnace Night Light stands at 5.3 inches tall and is perfect to perch on your bedside table, desk, or anywhere that needs a little extra light! [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0311b1/DSC00164.jpg" style="box-sizing: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 5px 15px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: 0.2s; transform: scale(1); max-width: 100%; display: block; margin: 16px auto;"][/img][/p][p]It requires 2 x AAA batteries, and then with a flick of a switch and you’re ready to watch it illuminate with a spectacular glow that will keep you cozy as you smelt through the night!

You can find out more and pre-order yours [url="https://youtooz.com/products/furnace-night-light"]here[/url].[/p]

newsitems.title: Rust's latest update adds mortars but 'no visual guide to help you land shells,' so get ready for some chaos
newsitems.author: Rick Lane
newsitems.contents: Facepunch Studios may have only just released S&box, but the launch of its spiritual successor to Garry's Mod has done nothing to slow down its monthly Rust update. It is as predictable as the tide, or having your base raided by your half-naked neighbours. This month's "Upgrade hard, raid harder" patch brings a major overhaul to one of Rust's key systems, though personally I'm more interested in the addition of mortars, sicko for explosions that I am... Read more.

newsitems.title: May's big Rust update adds new, rare workbench upgrades, if you can find them
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
The May Rust update is here, delivering on developer Facepunch's promise of mortars to put rooftop campers in their place. There's far more on offer here, with nine rare workbench upgrades headlining the new Rust patch notes. Steam's most beloved survival game also now boasts a refreshed vending machine UI to make trades smoother, along with improvements to the likes of tin can alarms and grenades. To round things out, Facepunch Studios has also launched a new Discord shop, and it's running a sale to mark the occasion.

Read the full story on PCGamesN: May's big Rust update adds new, rare workbench upgrades, if you can find them

newsitems.title: UPGRADE HARD, RAID HARDER
newsitems.author: Frog Hag
newsitems.contents:
[h2]WORKBENCH UPGRADES[/h2][p][/p][p]Workbenches have received a whole new upgrade system - along with nine upgrades to find and customise your benches with!
Each upgrade provides a different bonus effect, and you can mix and match them to find your favourite combos.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_workbenchupgrades_01.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_workbenchupgrades_05.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These upgrades are not craftable and will not be commonly found, so keep them safe!
Open the workbench's inventory to add your upgrades. They each have their own visual, which will alter the way the workbench looks.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_workbenchupgrades_02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_workbenchupgrades_UI_01.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you get lucky and collect 'em all, you'll have a fully upgraded workbench - both in terms of bonuses and visuals![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]MORTAR[/h2][p][/p][p]We're adding a new anti-personnel/raiding deployable weapon: Mortar![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danieltyler/1b0711b1/rust_mortar_1_1080_jpg.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Functionally really similar to cannons, but is instead placed on flat land and allows for launching projectiles over long distances. Firing a mortar requires mastery through trial & error as there is no visual guide to help you land shells exactly where you want them. Instead, you'll need to pair it with binoculars to estimate how high to aim the mortar for it to land on your target.[/p][p]To prevent repeated shots, the mortar has recoil that slightly bumps the mortar up on every shot, as well as a small inaccuracy that changes how far each shell lands. [/p][p]You can choose between two mortar shells, one aimed to deal high damage to players while the other focuses on destroying structures.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/danieltyler/1b0711b1/rust_mortar_2_1080_jpg.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]TIN CAN ALARM CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][p]The tin can alarm is getting a small update. You can now trap them with a bunch of different items.
[/p][p]How it operates has not changed, crossing its wire will trigger the trap and cause a loud clatter, alerting anyone nearby to your presence.[/p][p]And you can deploy it anywhere from your base to inside monuments. Use it strategically to cover access points and defend your positions.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_tincan_01.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When triggered, it'll throw the loaded item in place.

It supports:[/p][list][*][p]F1 Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Molotov[/p][/*][*][p]Bee Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Beancan Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Flashbang[/p][/*][*][p]Smoke Grenade[/p][/*][*][p]Supply Signal[/p][/*][*][p]Flare[/p][/*][*][p]Firecrackers[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_tincan_02.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Watch your step![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]VENDING MACHINE UI REFRESH[/h2][p][/p][p]The vending machine UI was in need of a refresh and some improvements.
We've totally redesigned the administration page and given the purchase page a new lick of paint.
[/p][p]The new administration page comes with a few features: being able to quickly setup vending orders via its in built inventory, selling skins individually, and being able to reorder your existing sell orders without deleting and recreating them.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ianhenderson/1b0211b1/rust_vending_machine_UI_4k.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ianhenderson/1b0211b1/rust_vending_machine_UI_2_4k.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]CRYPT STONE BUILDING SKIN[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re launching a new much-requested building skin to the permanent store this month; the Crypt stone building skin. [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/store/building/crypt"]Available now[/url] from the Rust store, this building skin allows you to change the visuals of your stone tier base. [/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/May2026_Crypt_Building_Skin_DLC_2_1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Your new home for eternity, or at least the next wipe.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/May2026_Crypt_Building_Skin_DLC_1_1080.jpg"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/May2026_Crypt_Building_Skin_DLC_7_1080.jpg"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/May2026_Crypt_Building_Skin_DLC_4_1080.jpg"][/img][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b2811b1/May2026_Crypt_Building_Skin_DLC_9_1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Purchasable from the in-game store or Steam item store. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NOTABLE CHANGES[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Computer Station now requires power[/b][/h3][p]Time to put that power supply to use[/p][h3][b]Grenade throw consistency[/b][/h3][p]Fixed some issues with 3rd person grenade throw animations[/p][h3][b]Floating City Vendor[/b][/h3][p]Floating City Boat Vendor now sells modular boat parts to get you back on your feet if you lose your boat (and a cheaper DPV too!)[/p][h3][b]Monument Building Radius[/b][/h3][p]Monuments which feature multiple no build zones now correctly display each one[/p][h3][b]Monument Road Signs[/b][/h3][p]Road signs are now correctly spawning in Outpost, Junkyard and Water wells[/p][h3][b]Boat Bow Drag[/b][/h3][p]Drag has been greatly increased for boats with a flat bow. Build accordingly[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]DISCORD X RUST SHOP[/h2][p][/p][p]Starting today (May 7th), we’re launching the official [url="https://discord.com/channels/560127830160048128/game-shop"]Rust Shop directly inside Discord[/url].

We’re actually only the second game to do this (shoutout to the Marvel Rivals team for going first), and the goal is pretty simple: making it easier to grab the skins and DLC you want, while you’re already hanging out with your team, browsing the goods right where you coordinate your raids.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/RUST-Shop-blog-1800x720.png"][/img][/p][p]To get things moving, we’re running a launch celebration for the first two weeks.[/p][p] 
From May 7th to May 21st, every single piece of Steam Item Store DLC released before 2026 will be 20% off. [/p][p]If you’ve been eyeing that specific building skin or hazmat suit for the last year, this is the time to snag it - or gift it to that special team mate.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/RUST-item-blog-1800x720.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s pretty seamless - anything you buy through the Discord Shop links straight to your Steam inventory. You can find the shop via our [url="https://discord.com/channels/560127830160048128/game-shop"]Official Discord[/url] or through the Discord Shop.
[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/channels/560127830160048128/game-shop"]Check it out[/url] and let us know what you think in the #feedback channels![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]RESKINNING DLC BARRELS[/h2][p][/p][p]We've now released several variants of the horizontal and vertical storage barrels but due to the fact that they don't have a common vanilla item (as opposed to something like the Tool Cupboard skins) they weren't compatible with the Spray Can/Repair Bench for swapping the skin.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_reskinnable_barrel_storage_2_1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've fixed that this month, allowing you to freely swap between the barrel skins. This will also be fixed for future versions of other DLC items we've released (eg. single and half height shelves).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2][p][/p][p]We're adding a new set of achievements related to the recent Naval Update. There are plenty of easy ones you should be able to get by just exploring the deep sea, as well as some more complicated hidden achievements that are a lot rarer in comparison - but should still come up within normal play.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0511b1/may2026_deep_sea_achievements_1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Can you spot them all?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]FIX HELD ANIMATIONS STOPPING EARLY[/h2][p][/p][p]There has been a longstanding issue where if a player uses the last item in a stack, the viewmodel and player animations for using that item will stop immediately upon the item having been spent. Without affecting the timing of when items are determined to have been used (as changing this would have gameplay/balance implications), we now have a means of setting up animations to stick around after the item has been spent so they can be play out nicely before stopping. 

This has been applied to all grenade types, as well as the bandage and medical syringe, and will be applied to the other held items over time.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SERVER BROWSER UPDATE[/h2][p][/p][p]We've made some changes to the server browser.

It was possible in the past for server owners to be able to spoof ping information through various means. This would make servers show lower in ping that were actually higher in ping to you, possibly picking a server which would end up feeling laggy when your intention was to pick a local server.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ianhenderson/1b0511b1/rust_server_browser_1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We're rolling out a new system: country mapping. Based on the servers IP we get an estimate of what country the server is in, as well as its coordinates. We use those coordinates to sort servers close to you. This means that servers can no longer spoof where they are located. [/p][p]
For the above system to work we also need to estimate where you are located (in order to show your servers nearby). This is located at the top left of the play menu and can be overridden by you. This override is saved between sessions if you'd rather have it done manually.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ianhenderson/1b0511b1/rust_server_browser_4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]BINOCULAR REFRESH[/h2][p][/p][p]Binoculars have had a whole refresh![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ianhenderson/1b0211b1/rust_binoculars_2_4k_tweaked.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The model, animations and UI have all been updated to feel more modern.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ianhenderson/1b0211b1/rust_binoculars_3_4k.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Right click to peer through the binoculars and Left click to cycle the three zoom levels.
And it pairs nicely with the new mortar![/p][p]Crafting cost has been reduced too![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]SALVAGED CLEAVER REMAKE[/h2][p][/p][p]Last month we revisited the Salvaged Axe, with a full visual and animation overhaul. This month, we’ve given the same treatment to another legacy favourite — the Salvaged Cleaver ![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/alfiebirch/1b0111b1/may2026_salvagedcleaver_01.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Salvaged Cleaver has received a complete remake, featuring a brand-new high-quality 3D model, updated HD textures, and an entirely new animation set.[/p][p]The result is a weapon that looks like it was lovingly rebuilt from junk… and still very much wants to live in your enemies’ ribs.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW WORKSHOP SKINNABLE: ELECTRIC FURNACE[/h2][p][/p][p]This month’s workshop skinnable is the Electric Furnace[/p][p]There are so many possibilities with skins for this item, especially as it lights up. We can’t wait to see what the community cooks up![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/matti/1b3011b1/may2026_workshop_skinnable_electric_furnace_1_1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To make your own Electric Furnace skin, head over to the in-game workshop and locate the Electric Furnace deployable item. From there, you can download the model file and add your own materials.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]TWITCH RIVALS - BASE INVADERS[/h2][p][/p][p]Twitch Rivals - Base Invaders is back!
[/p][p]Watch and earn an exclusive Twitch Rivals [b]HMLMG[/b] skin for [b]one day only[/b]! 
This drop will be tied to the [url="https://www.twitch.tv/twitchrivals"]Twitch Rivals channel[/url] and only active during the broadcast window. [/p][p]20 teams of 5 will battle it out, while 5 general Twitch Drops are available for 5 days only![/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/Errn/1b0711b1/td_50-blog-image.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Drops start:[/b] May 13th - 11AM PT/ 2PM ET/ 7PM BST 
[b]Drops end:[/b] May 18th - Midnight PT / 3AM ET / 8AM BST

Connect your accounts to claim your drops! [/p][p][url="https://twitch.facepunch.com/"]https://twitch.facepunch.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]PERFORMANCE: BATCHED PLAYER PROCESSING[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Removal of UsePlayerUpdateJobs 0/1[/b][/h3][p]Last [url="https://rust.facepunch.com/news/spring-clean#PerformanceUsePlayerUpdateJobsUpgrade"]update[/url] I mentioned that I was planning to remove old player processing code. The vanilla (UsePlayerUpdateJobs 0) and our first version of batching (Jobs 1) mode code has been removed. You can still set UsePlayerUpdateJobs to lower than default 2, but it won't have any effect and it'll run as if it's set to 2.[/p][h3][b]UsePlayerUpdateJobs 3 still experimental[/b][/h3][p]This patch we've made a couple bug fixes and tweaks that should both reduce number of garbage allocated for creating tasks every frame (our fork of UniTask can now reliably pool internals) and improved scheduling of physics queries for our server-side player checks. We're going to be switching some of our servers for Jobs 3 mode and seeing how they run over next month. If it holds, we'll promote it to default.[/p][h3][b]Going forward[/b][/h3][p]Alongside above, we're also working on eliminating some of the bottlenecks that prevent us from more heavily relying on parallelization:[/p][list][*][p]The way our Pool is implemented causes a lot of contention on a singular lock - I'd like to ship an improvement in Jobs 3[/p][/*][*][p]We still have a lot of player state that's stored in a way that prevents us from converting to Burst code and having to run recaching logic every frame - it would be gradually completed in Jobs 3 and future modes[/p][/*][*][p]We need to find a way to make entity saving multithreading safe (which means no Unity API calling) - hoping to tackle for Jobs 4[/p][/*][/list][p]We're slowly getting to the point where player processing is not the slowest part of the server workload. I'd like to squeeze out as much benefit as I can while it's still worthwhile before moving to the next big server performance problem.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]DEEP SEA LOOT BALANCE[/h2][p][/p][p]We've reduced the amount of loot you can find in the Deep Sea.[/p][p][img src="https://files.facepunch.com/ashcoook/1b0311b1/rust_islands_20_1080.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Loot found in that side of the map was a little too generous compared to the other monuments and areas in the game.

However, Scientist boats will also have less guns overall.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]WINDOWS SERVER 2016 EOL ANNOUNCEMENT[/h2][p][/p][p]We are currently in the process of upgrading to Unity 6. This means Windows Server 2016 / Windows 8 and older will no longer be supported. The minimum required version will be Windows Server 2019 / Windows 10 Version 21H1 (Build 19043) or newer.[/p][p]From our metrics none of our players are still on Windows 7 or Windows 8, so we aren't concerned about that. However, we suspect some server hosts are still running Windows Server 2016. If you run a Rust server, consider this the first and final notice that you need to upgrade to at least Windows Server 2019 by the end of the month.[/p]
